FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Tellent Recruitee?

Tellent Recruitee is a customizable, easy-to-use Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and recruitment software that helps recruitment teams hire faster, stay aligned, and make better hiring decisions — all in one place.

It covers the full recruitment journey: building your careers site, posting jobs, screening candidates, collaborating with hiring managers, sending offer letters, and handing off new hires to your HRIS. Trusted by 7,000+ companies and 180,000+ daily users across 120+ countries.

Who is Tellent Recruitee built for?

Tellent Recruitee is built for growth-stage and mid-market organizations, typically between 50 and 1,000 employees, at the point where hiring is accelerating, and informal processes no longer keep up.

It's used by two main groups: business leaders in smaller organizations who own hiring without a dedicated HR function, and growing People and Talent teams — recruiters, hiring managers, and Heads of HR, People, or Recruitment — who need everyone working from the same process.

If you're managing multiple open roles, coordinating with hiring managers, and trying to build a consistent, scalable process, Tellent Recruitee is built for you.

What hiring challenges does Tellent Recruitee solve?

Most teams come to Tellent Recruitee with one or more of these problems:

  • Hiring scattered across spreadsheets and inboxes
  • Hiring managers giving feedback late — or not at all
  • No visibility into where candidates stand at any given moment
  • Too much time lost to admin and repetitive manual tasks
  • No reliable way to show hiring impact to leadership
  • Slow or impersonal candidate communication — candidates left waiting, responses are generic
  • Hiring decisions based on gut feeling, not data

Tellent Recruitee brings structure, automation, and collaboration into one place, so your team spends less time managing the process and more time on the people.

Does Tellent Recruitee integrate with my existing tools?

Yes. Tellent Recruitee connects with 200+ tools via the Tellent Marketplace — including HRIS platforms, calendars (Google, Outlook), video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet), job boards, LinkedIn, and more.

For custom setups, you can also use the API and webhooks to build exactly the integrations your team needs.

Browse integrations on the Tellent Marketplace →

Can Tellent Recruitee replace spreadsheets and manual email processes?

Yes, and that's what it's purposefully built for. Tellent Recruitee brings everything into one place — candidate data, hiring manager feedback, interview scheduling, team communication, job posting and promotion, and reporting — so nothing gets lost across spreadsheets, inboxes, and shared drives.

Everyone works from the same information, and repetitive steps are automated. In a survey of our customers, 94% reported significantly fewer manual tasks after switching to Tellent Recruitee.

How much does Tellent Recruitee cost?

Pricing is based on the plan you choose (Start, Advance, or Optimize), your organization's size, and your billing period. Paying annually gives you a 20% discount. All plans require a minimum one-year commitment, with the option to pay monthly.

To get a price tailored to your team, book a 30-minute demo or visit our pricing page to see our plans and packaging. Want to build a business case first? Use our ROI calculator to estimate your potential savings.

How is Tellent Recruitee different from other ATSs?

Here's what sets us apart:

  • Unlimited users on all plans: no per-seat pricing that discourages collaboration
  • Built around your process, not the other way around: customize pipelines, workflows, templates, and settings to match how your team already hires
  • Fully branded candidate experience: your careers site runs on your own domain, with no vendor branding in candidate touchpoints
  • Built in Europe, compliant globally: GDPR at its core, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, with support for EEOC in the US
  • Native WhatsApp integration: candidates can apply and communicate via WhatsApp, with no third-party tool required
  • A platform people actually want to use: no IT or training required; intuitive enough for hiring managers, powerful enough for recruiters
  • Part of Tellent's modular People Decision Platform: start with recruiting, and add Core HR and performance management when you're ready, all on the same system

About the job

Tether is seeking a Blockchain Expansion Manager to drive strategic growth initiatives across Tether’s blockchain partner ecosystem. This role sits within the Blockchain Expansion function and focuses on building and managing high-impact relationships with blockchain foundations while executing strategic projects that expand the real-world adoption and utility of Tether assets.

The Blockchain Expansion Manager will work closely with blockchain partners to design and deliver initiatives that meaningfully grow Tether’s asset usage through practical, real-world use cases. This role requires strong partnership management skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to execute complex projects across multiple internal and external stakeholders.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, operates with autonomy, and brings structure and rigor to high-impact growth initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and deepen strategic relationships with blockchain foundations and ecosystem partners.
    Act as the primary point of contact for assigned blockchain partners, ensuring alignment between partner objectives and Tether’s strategic priorities.

  • Design and execute high-impact growth projects in collaboration with blockchain partners to drive adoption of Tether assets through real-world use cases.

  • Think strategically about how Tether can work with blockchain ecosystems to create scalable, sustainable projects that expand asset usage and circulation.

  • Coordinate and manage cross-functional initiatives involving regional expansion, economics, marketing, and other internal teams.

  • Track, manage, and report on project progress, outcomes, and effectiveness, ensuring initiatives deliver against defined objectives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency, project structure, and partner outcomes.

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking initiative to identify new opportunities and drive them forward.

  • Support internal leadership with clear updates, insights, and recommendations based on partner and project performance.

Job requirements

Mandatory

  • Proven experience in partnership or ecosystem management, ideally within crypto, fintech, or technology.

  • Strong track record of managing high-impact, strategic growth projects from concept through execution.

  • Excellent organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Ability to track, manage, and optimise multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate ideas into executable projects.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as expansion, economics, marketing, or product.

  • Ability to work autonomously, take initiative, and operate effectively in a remote, global environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience working with blockchain foundations or Layer 1 / Layer 2 ecosystems.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, or real-world blockchain use cases.

  • Experience operating in fast-growing or unstructured environments.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

  • Remote

Job description

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly driven Expansion Manager to expand Tether’s growth and presence in Cote d’Ivoire through adoption of its solutions, products and services. The Expansion Manager will play a pivotal role in identifying and executing new business opportunities, establishing strategic partnerships, and navigating regulatory landscapes. This role requires close collaboration with internal teams to develop and implement go-to-market strategies in Cote d’Ivoire and across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional who believes in financial inclusion, digital currencies, and driving innovation in Africa’s financial ecosystem. Frequent local and international travel is required.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record in business development, market expansion, and partnership management. You have:

  • A degree in Business, Management, or Finance (MBA preferred).

  • Strong analytical skills and experience in setting/monitoring KPIs.

  • A proactive, independent, and well-organized approach to work.

  • The ability to thrive autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • A history of successfully building and managing strategic partnerships.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, engage, and secure new business opportunities in Cote d’Ivoire and in the Francophone region.

  • Build strong relationships with partners, customers, and stakeholders.

  • Build and manage commercial and strategic partnerships with Ivorian banks, fintechs and large corporates

  • Develop pipeline of USDt integration opportunities across the Francophone countries payment ecosystem

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Design and implement go-to-market strategies to expand Tether’s products and services.

  • Track and analyze KPIs to assess and optimize market strategies.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify trends, threats, and growth opportunities.

  • Analyze USDt and fiat flows for data-driven decision-making.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess their business impact.

Stakeholder & Government Engagement

  • Manage relationships with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies.

  • Represent the company at key meetings and industry events.

Marketing & Community Engagement

  • Support and participate in fintech events, conferences, and meetups to enhance brand visibility.

Job requirements

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of the Francophone market, culture, and regulations in blockchain, fintech, finance, remittances, and payments.

  • Existing relationships at BCEAO and national central banks across WAEMU

  • 7-10 years work experience in cross-border settlements, mobile money, and/or payment infrastructures; telecom or banking experience is a plus.

  • Fluent in English and French (native preferred), with a Business, Management, or Finance degree (MBA preferred).

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with partners, regulators, and stakeholders.

  • Proven experience in partnerships, KPI monitoring, and business growth.

  • Analytical, strategic, and results-driven with problem-solving skills.

  • Entrepreneurial background and project management expertise.

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments with international travel readiness.

About the team + role

The Credit Cards & Banking team is part of Robinhood’s Money Engineering organization. This team builds the products and systems behind some of Robinhood’s most ambitious consumer experiences, including Robinhood Gold Credit Card, Banking, and the next generation of card and banking products.

This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of product innovation, scale, and reliability. Our team owns the full customer experience end to end—from mobile and frontend surfaces to backend systems and the infrastructure that powers them. We work on products used by millions, in a space where execution quality, technical rigor, and customer trust matter deeply.

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of engineers building category-defining credit card and banking experiences. You’ll partner closely with product, design, data, compliance, operations, and peer engineering teams to define the roadmap, make sound technical decisions, and deliver exceptional products at scale. You’ll also play a central role in hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team.

We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and leaders who want to help build the future of money.

This role is based in our Menlo Park Ca, New York, NY, or Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, grow, and support a team of software engineers working on Robinhood’s Credit Cards & Banking product area
  • Set clear direction for the team across execution, technical design, and people development
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define roadmaps and deliver high-impact customer experiences
  • Drive the architecture, execution, and operational excellence needed to build reliable, scalable card and banking systems
  • Guide engineering decisions across product surfaces, backend services, and platform dependencies
  • Improve team health and effectiveness through strong planning, prioritization, feedback, and career development
  • Hire exceptional engineers and raise the bar on talent, performance, and engineering craftsmanship
  • Help the team move quickly while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and customer trust

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • Experience leading teams that build and ship customer-facing products at scale
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to partner closely on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
  • Experience working on complex distributed systems, backend services, or full-stack consumer products
  • A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch
  • Experience coaching and developing engineers through regular feedback, performance management, and career growth
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical partner
  • A high bar for execution, product quality, and building strong teams

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires strong leaders who can build both exceptional products and exceptional teams. We’re looking for someone who can:

  • Drive high performance through clear goals, strong accountability, and fast learning
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar and investing deeply in team development
  • Create clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Build trust across functions and keep teams aligned around customer and business impact
  • Raise the quality of both technical execution and people leadership

Bonus points

  • Experience in fintech, banking, credit cards, payments, lending, or other highly regulated domains
  • Experience leading teams through periods of rapid growth, product expansion, or platform scaling
  • Experience building mobile-first or consumer app experiences
  • Familiarity with modern backend and data systems in high-availability environments

  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The credit risk operations team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. This team will directly impact the company's bottom line and growth capabilities by supporting new and emerging businesses. The Credit Operations team is responsible for conducting credit risk assessments, underwriting small and mid-size users, and proposing mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks for our users.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will manage and develop a group of Credit Risk Operations Associates that are focused on commercial credit underwriting and risk mitigation. The Credit Risk Operations Team Lead will cultivate the engagement of their team members while guiding them to be the best they can be, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This means helping to set team goals, and using metrics to efficiently measure and guide team performance in pursuit of those goals. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, possess a deep understanding of commercial credit risk, be able to move quickly, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, coach, and develop a new team of in-office Credit Risk Operations Associates
  • Execute on commercial credit underwriting frameworks that allow your team to evaluate business models and financial statements of successful venture-backed startups to established entities
  • Guide your team to identify commercial credit risk and propose risk mitigation strategies
  • Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to maintain credit risk tolerance and  balance credit  loss and customer experience
  • Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career
  • Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance
  • Be data-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making
  • Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment
  • Manage operational performance to deliver KPIs
  • Manage capacity and scheduling to ensure adequate coverage
  • Help resolve roadblocks and issues as they arise
  • Act as a point of escalation for complex credit underwriting reviews

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A minimum of 6+ years of experience with commercial credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, risk modeling and cash flow forecasting
  • The ability to transform business and financial data into a cohesive narrative that outlines potential credit risks and presents dynamic mitigation strategies
  • At least 2+ years of direct people management experience
  • Leadership skills, strong analytical abilities, and excellent communication skills are essential
  • An ability to partner effectively with internal globally distributed stakeholders
  • Strong operational background including new process launches and service delivery
  • Skill and credibility doing the core work of a user facing team with a high bar for quality, and a willingness to lead by example
  • Passion for process improvement and innovation

Preferred qualifications

  • Degree/diploma in Finance or Accounting, or a related field
  • Experience in payments, e-commerce, or fintech mitigating credit risk
  • Experience in building and scaling new teams

Build the Future of Finance

Browse Openings
Our mission is to democratize finance for all.
An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. Join us if you’d like to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift.
We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.

“Technology is rapidly disrupting the financial services industry. In this technological competition, victory will go to the sharpest and most hardcore team.”

Vlad TenevCo-Founder and CEO

How we build

We are a collaborative, intensely driven team operating at the highest level of performance. This isn’t a place for the complacent. It’s where ambition makes ideas a reality and careers accelerate at full speed. Here's what you'll find if you join us:

Ethics and compliance are at the center of what we do.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards of ethics and regulatory compliance, as we know customer trust is hard earned and easily lost. See our Code of Conduct here.

We operate with an extreme sense of urgency.

The world's not slowing down, and neither are we. Working here is intense, urgent, and fast-moving by design. We run toward hard problems and push through all-out sprints for purposeful work that makes real-world impact in weeks, not years.

We believe in doing more with less.

Our hiring and promotions aren't about who's led the biggest team, but who's led lean teams to big results. We care about execution, not title. Prioritizing delivery over hierarchy helps us operate more like a start-up, even at our scale.

Bureaucracy won't slow you down.

We're builders. We eliminate barriers to direct feedback and are allergic to unnecessary processes. It may sound simple, but time is too valuable to waste - for our teams and especially for our customers.

Expectations are high; excellence is rewarded.

Our talent programs are designed to recognize and motivate high performance. The exceptionally talented people who thrive here are chasing impact, not status. They're here to build, deliver and consistently raise the bar.

Hear from our team

Hear from our team

“We’re not dragging outdated legacy systems into the future — we’re built on a modern stack, using the best technology.”

“It’s intense, but in the best way. We move fast because we care deeply about what we ship.”

– Tanya D., Crypto
– Tam B., Engineering

“You’ll never hear ‘that’s not my job’ around here. Everyone’s in it together

—when we win, it’s as a team.”

“Hard questions aren’t a threat here — they’re expected. Everyone’s hands-on and good ideas win over big egos.”

– Oren N., Customer Experience
– Gina P., Brokerage

What We Value at Robinhood

Insane Customer Focus

Insane Customer Focus

Our customers are why we exist. We listen to them, design for their needs, and aim to make our user experience elegant and intuitive.

We put what's best for customers at the center of decision-making, bringing them the best in technology coupled with real value. When there are customer pain points, we fix them quickly.

High Performance

High Performance

We operate with extreme urgency. We push for progress without compromising quality-and when something is broken, we fix it. We're driven by impact and pride ourselves in our ability to be nimble and quickly adjust our strategy when presented with new information. Friction and obstacles don't deter us from pursuing what's truly important.

Safety Always

Safety Always

Trust is hard earned and easily lost. We take responsibility for our customers' finances seriously. We are compliant, approach risks thoughtfully, and never compromise trust for speed.

One Robinhood

One Robinhood

We're all invested in the same mission. We earn each other's trust through honesty, inclusion, and respect - because finger-pointing never does the trick. We invite contrary perspectives, support each other, and debate with energy and kindness. Once decisions are made, we move in unison with ownership and accountability, powered by the thrill of building something great together.

Participation is Power

Participation is Power

We level the playing field. We started a movement, breaking barriers so everyone—not just the wealthy—can access the financial system. The elites always find a way to get nicer things, which means our job to "democratize finance for all" may never be complete — which is what makes it so fun.

First-Principles Thinking

First-Principles Thinking

When we want to lead, we lead. We're innovators and problem solvers. Rather than iterating on the past, we start from first principles, questioning assumptions and finding creative solutions from square one. We use data, empirical truth, and experiments to inform decisions. Our bold bets often make us a first mover, and we do what's right for customers - even if it hasn't been done before.

Lean and Disciplined

Lean and Disciplined

We do more with less. Constraint drives us to innovate through scalable technology-not excess resources. We set ambitious goals, benchmark performance, and weigh trade offs before changing course. We respect each other's time by reducing toil and bureaucracy. And by keeping costs low and efficiency high, we deliver exceptional value customers can't find anywhere else.

We Invest in Top Talent

We're making Robinhood the best place to build with AI by investing heavily in top-tier tools and continuous skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Here you are empowered to learn and accelerate your impact using AI.

Your Growth

Challenging work that becomes a force multiplier on your career

  • Own high-impact work from the start
  • Tackle tough problems that actually matter
  • Build with top talent and learn from the best
  • Learn fast in a culture that values direct feedback

Your Lifestyle

Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work

  • Best-in-class medical, dental, vision
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account
  • 401(k) matching
  • Commuter stipends
  • Life & disability insurance
  • Fertility benefits
  • Parental leave
  • Mental health benefits
  • Tax-advantaged accounts
  • Paid time off to recharge

Rewards vary by employment type/location.

Your Rewards

Outsized rewards for outsized performance

  • Performance-driven compensation; multipliers for exceptional impact
  • Bonus programs tied to business and individual results
  • Ownership through equity + Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund with exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds (for eligible US employees)

Rewards vary by employment type/location.

Your Community

Collaborative, inclusive workplace to drive connection and empower performance

  • Internal communities like Employee Resource Groups and Clubs
  • Culture of direct feedback with tools to support it
  • Environment where all perspectives are valued across levels
  • Community involvement, and volunteer time off
  • Environment, Social, and Governance practices and reporting

Your Office Life

Exceptional office experience to unlock the power of in-person work

  • Excellent food, snacks, and catered meals
  • Events and offsites
  • Regular connections with leadership, like weekly All Hands
  • Comfortable workspaces that spark innovation
  • Most roles are office-based with locations in:
    • Menlo Park, CA
    • New York, NY
    • Denver, CO
    • Washington, DC
    • Westlake, TX
    • Chicago, IL
    • Lake Mary, FL

    • London, UK (Industrious)
    • Singapore (WeWork)
    • Toronto, ON (WeWork)
    • Ljubljana, SL (Bitstamp by Robinhood)
    • Maribor, SL (Bitstamp by Robinhood)
    • Luxembourg (Bitstamp by Robinhood)

Our mission is to democratize finance for all.
An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. Join us if you’d like to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift.
We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.

“Technology is rapidly disrupting the financial services industry. In this technological competition, victory will go to the sharpest and most hardcore team.”

Vlad TenevCo-Founder and CEO

How we build

We are a collaborative, intensely driven team operating at the highest level of performance. This isn’t a place for the complacent. It’s where ambition makes ideas a reality and careers accelerate at full speed. Here's what you'll find if you join us:

Ethics and compliance are at the center of what we do.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards of ethics and regulatory compliance, as we know customer trust is hard earned and easily lost. See our Code of Conduct here.

We operate with an extreme sense of urgency.

The world's not slowing down, and neither are we. Working here is intense, urgent, and fast-moving by design. We run toward hard problems and push through all-out sprints for purposeful work that makes real-world impact in weeks, not years.

We believe in doing more with less.

Our hiring and promotions aren't about who's led the biggest team, but who's led lean teams to big results. We care about execution, not title. Prioritizing delivery over hierarchy helps us operate more like a start-up, even at our scale.

Bureaucracy won't slow you down.

We're builders. We eliminate barriers to direct feedback and are allergic to unnecessary processes. It may sound simple, but time is too valuable to waste - for our teams and especially for our customers.

Expectations are high; excellence is rewarded.

Our talent programs are designed to recognize and motivate high performance. The exceptionally talented people who thrive here are chasing impact, not status. They're here to build, deliver and consistently raise the bar.

Hear from our team

Hear from our team

“We’re not dragging outdated legacy systems into the future — we’re built on a modern stack, using the best technology.”

“It’s intense, but in the best way. We move fast because we care deeply about what we ship.”

– Tam B., Engineering

“You’ll never hear ‘that’s not my job’ around here. Everyone’s in it together

—when we win, it’s as a team.”

“Hard questions aren’t a threat here — they’re expected. Everyone’s hands-on and good ideas win over big egos.”

– Oren N., Customer Experience
– Gina P., Brokerage

What We Value at Robinhood

Insane Customer Focus

Insane Customer Focus

Our customers are why we exist. We listen to them, design for their needs, and aim to make our user experience elegant and intuitive.

We put what's best for customers at the center of decision-making, bringing them the best in technology coupled with real value. When there are customer pain points, we fix them quickly.

High Performance

High Performance

We operate with extreme urgency. We push for progress without compromising quality-and when something is broken, we fix it. We're driven by impact and pride ourselves in our ability to be nimble and quickly adjust our strategy when presented with new information. Friction and obstacles don't deter us from pursuing what's truly important.

Safety Always

Safety Always

Trust is hard earned and easily lost. We take responsibility for our customers' finances seriously. We are compliant, approach risks thoughtfully, and never compromise trust for speed.

One Robinhood

One Robinhood

We're all invested in the same mission. We earn each other's trust through honesty, inclusion, and respect - because finger-pointing never does the trick. We invite contrary perspectives, support each other, and debate with energy and kindness. Once decisions are made, we move in unison with ownership and accountability, powered by the thrill of building something great together.

Participation is Power

Participation is Power

We level the playing field. We started a movement, breaking barriers so everyone—not just the wealthy—can access the financial system. The elites always find a way to get nicer things, which means our job to "democratize finance for all" may never be complete — which is what makes it so fun.

First-Principles Thinking

First-Principles Thinking

When we want to lead, we lead. We're innovators and problem solvers. Rather than iterating on the past, we start from first principles, questioning assumptions and finding creative solutions from square one. We use data, empirical truth, and experiments to inform decisions. Our bold bets often make us a first mover, and we do what's right for customers - even if it hasn't been done before.

Lean and Disciplined

Lean and Disciplined

We do more with less. Constraint drives us to innovate through scalable technology-not excess resources. We set ambitious goals, benchmark performance, and weigh trade offs before changing course. We respect each other's time by reducing toil and bureaucracy. And by keeping costs low and efficiency high, we deliver exceptional value customers can't find anywhere else.

We Invest in Top Talent

We're making Robinhood the best place to build with AI by investing heavily in top-tier tools and continuous skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Here you are empowered to learn and accelerate your impact using AI.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team & role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Bitstamp made history in 2011 as the world’s first regulated crypto exchange. Today, we are entering an ambitious new chapter as part of the Robinhood family. The Risk team's mission is to safeguard Robinhood's operations by providing robust second-line oversight of technology and cyber risk. We focus on protecting our customers and maintaining the trust of regulators and partners. We collaborate with security, engineering, and product teams to ensure our technology arrangements are resilient and secure. Our team values rigorous analysis, open communication, and proactive risk management! Together, we ensure that our digital asset and brokerage services scale safely.

As ICT Risk Oversight Lead, you will serve as a key representative of the second line of defense for cyber and technology risk, providing independent challenge and oversight across technology operations, major change initiatives, risk appetite monitoring, and cyber and IT governance. In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within our risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, and support regulatory alignment. You will also help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities. This is an exciting opportunity to report directly to the Head of Risk & Authorized Manager and drive the safety of our Luxembourg operations!

In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, support regulatory alignment, and help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Bitstamp by Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Implement and enhance the ICT Risk Management framework, including policies and procedures, in alignment with Robinhood group standards and Bitstamp's jurisdictional regulatory requirements.
  • Provide 2LOD oversight and monitoring across key technology and security initiatives and business-as-usual operations, including the review of and identification of issues, and ongoing review of risk metrics and indicators.
  • Carry out risk assessments for new products and for existing systems, processes, and technology arrangements.
  • Act in a 2LOD capacity collaborating with the IT and Security organizations, including close partnership with CISO and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Enhance the risk appetite framework and KRIs for ICT risks, perform independent reviews, and provide independent challenge to 1LOD.
  • Report findings, risk themes, and regular updates through established governance cadences and management bodies.
  • Promote ICT risk awareness and help strengthen risk culture across the organization.
  • Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of experience in cyber, technology, or ICT risk, with a strong understanding of second line oversight, control effectiveness, and independent challenge.
  • Experience in a highly regulated environment, ideally in financial services, including interaction with regulatory expectations and governance processes.
  • Strong understanding of ICT, cyber, and operational risks specific to cryptocurrency and digital asset businesses, including exchange and custody models, third-party dependencies, technology resilience, and heightened regulatory expectations.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.
  • Experience across technology risk, control assurance, incident response, and internal control environments; technology audit experience is a strong plus.
  • Ability to assess complex technology and security risks, provide practical challenge to first-line teams, and influence outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in business continuity, identity and access management, secure software development.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are strongly preferred; ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or similar certifications are a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively across functions.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs.
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to be the technical lead across Ripple's diverse product and business portfolio. You'll define the analytics vision, build the scientific frameworks the org uses to evaluate product and business performance, and use AI tooling to accelerate the speed and reach of analytics across the company.

In this role, you'll partner with product and business leads to frame the most important questions, set the analytical bar, and ensure decisions across surfaces rest on a consistent, thorough foundation. You'll operate as a force multiplier -- solving the hardest problems, building the frameworks others reuse, and levelling up data scientists across teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  •  Be the DS tech lead across multiple product and business teams: setting methodological standards and unblocking the hardest analytical problems across areas including Treasury, Markets, Custody, and XRPL.
  • Partner with product and business leads to define analytics strategy: shaping which initiatives to invest in, what success looks like, and how we'll know.
  • Build the scientific frameworks Ripple reuses at scale: product and network health metrics, causal inference playbooks, liquidity and adoption models, and forecasting approaches that work across institutional and developer surfaces.
  • Pioneer AI-accelerated analytics: applying LLMs and agentic workflows to scale insight generation, automate routine analysis, and enable self-serve exploration for non-DS partners.
  • Drive evidence-based evaluation of growth across customers, corridors, and on-chain activity, surfacing the causal drivers behind adoption and volume.
  • Define and communicate the metrics leadership runs on: translating complex results into clear narratives for Ripple executives and external stakeholders.
  • Raise the bar for the DS function through thought leadership and mentorship across embedded teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 8+ years in data science or quantitative analysis, with a track record of senior level impact across multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across cross-functional teams, influencing roadmaps and strategy at both executive and execution levels.
  • Proven experience designing reusable analytics and measurement frameworks that scale across products.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to accelerate analytics workflows (agentic analysis, AI-assisted insight generation, natural-language data interfaces).
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, and statistical modeling in a product environment.
  • Expertise in Python or R, fluency in SQL, and experience with large-scale data tech (Databricks, Airflow, dBT a plus).
  • Experience with FinTech, payments, crypto, or blockchain data is a strong plus.
  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in a quantitative field preferred.
  • Exceptional communication skills — able to turn technical depth into executive-ready narratives.

CA Annual Base Salary Range
$1—$2 USD

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

  • Employee giving match

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge

  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Our mission is to democratize finance for all.
An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. Join us if you’d like to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift.
We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.

“Technology is rapidly disrupting the financial services industry. In this technological competition, victory will go to the sharpest and most hardcore team.”

Vlad TenevCo-Founder and CEO

How we build

We are a collaborative, intensely driven team operating at the highest level of performance. This isn’t a place for the complacent. It’s where ambition makes ideas a reality and careers accelerate at full speed. Here's what you'll find if you join us:

Ethics and compliance are at the center of what we do.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards of ethics and regulatory compliance, as we know customer trust is hard earned and easily lost. See our Code of Conduct here.

We operate with an extreme sense of urgency.

The world's not slowing down, and neither are we. Working here is intense, urgent, and fast-moving by design. We run toward hard problems and push through all-out sprints for purposeful work that makes real-world impact in weeks, not years.

We believe in doing more with less.

Our hiring and promotions aren't about who's led the biggest team, but who's led lean teams to big results. We care about execution, not title. Prioritizing delivery over hierarchy helps us operate more like a start-up, even at our scale.

Bureaucracy won't slow you down.

We're builders. We eliminate barriers to direct feedback and are allergic to unnecessary processes. It may sound simple, but time is too valuable to waste - for our teams and especially for our customers.

Expectations are high; excellence is rewarded.

Our talent programs are designed to recognize and motivate high performance. The exceptionally talented people who thrive here are chasing impact, not status. They're here to build, deliver and consistently raise the bar.

Hear from our team

Hear from our team

“We’re not dragging outdated legacy systems into the future — we’re built on a modern stack, using the best technology.”

“It’s intense, but in the best way. We move fast because we care deeply about what we ship.”

– Tam B., Engineering

“You’ll never hear ‘that’s not my job’ around here. Everyone’s in it together

—when we win, it’s as a team.”

“Hard questions aren’t a threat here — they’re expected. Everyone’s hands-on and good ideas win over big egos.”

– Oren N., Customer Experience
– Gina P., Brokerage

What We Value at Robinhood

Insane Customer Focus

Insane Customer Focus

Our customers are why we exist. We listen to them, design for their needs, and aim to make our user experience elegant and intuitive.

We put what's best for customers at the center of decision-making, bringing them the best in technology coupled with real value. When there are customer pain points, we fix them quickly.

High Performance

High Performance

We operate with extreme urgency. We push for progress without compromising quality-and when something is broken, we fix it. We're driven by impact and pride ourselves in our ability to be nimble and quickly adjust our strategy when presented with new information. Friction and obstacles don't deter us from pursuing what's truly important.

Safety Always

Safety Always

Trust is hard earned and easily lost. We take responsibility for our customers' finances seriously. We are compliant, approach risks thoughtfully, and never compromise trust for speed.

One Robinhood

One Robinhood

We're all invested in the same mission. We earn each other's trust through honesty, inclusion, and respect - because finger-pointing never does the trick. We invite contrary perspectives, support each other, and debate with energy and kindness. Once decisions are made, we move in unison with ownership and accountability, powered by the thrill of building something great together.

Participation is Power

Participation is Power

We level the playing field. We started a movement, breaking barriers so everyone—not just the wealthy—can access the financial system. The elites always find a way to get nicer things, which means our job to "democratize finance for all" may never be complete — which is what makes it so fun.

First-Principles Thinking

First-Principles Thinking

When we want to lead, we lead. We're innovators and problem solvers. Rather than iterating on the past, we start from first principles, questioning assumptions and finding creative solutions from square one. We use data, empirical truth, and experiments to inform decisions. Our bold bets often make us a first mover, and we do what's right for customers - even if it hasn't been done before.

Lean and Disciplined

Lean and Disciplined

We do more with less. Constraint drives us to innovate through scalable technology-not excess resources. We set ambitious goals, benchmark performance, and weigh trade offs before changing course. We respect each other's time by reducing toil and bureaucracy. And by keeping costs low and efficiency high, we deliver exceptional value customers can't find anywhere else.

We Invest in Top Talent

We're making Robinhood the best place to build with AI by investing heavily in top-tier tools and continuous skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Here you are empowered to learn and accelerate your impact using AI.

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We bring deep technical and industry knowledge to complex customer opportunities, advise the broader pre-sales organisation, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, and provide critical market insight to Stripe’s product and engineering teams.

This role will be Stripe’s dedicated Payments and Optimised Checkout specialist in APAC. Based in Singapore, you will support complex and strategic opportunities across Southeast Asia, Australia/New Zealand, and Greater China particularly those involving Managed Payments, Adaptive Pricing, Optimised Checkout Suite (OCS), multi-currency payments, and local payment methods.

As an early specialist hire in-region, you will have significant autonomy to shape how Stripe brings these solutions to market across APAC. You will report into a global team outside the region, so success in this role requires strong self-direction, excellent communication, and comfort operating through ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

You will partner closely with product, sales and core pre-sales teams to progress strategic opportunities, drive pipeline and revenue, and help customers design high-performing payment experiences. You will act as a trusted technical and business advisor to senior customer stakeholders, translating complex payment infrastructure into practical architectures and measurable business outcomes.

You will use your payments expertise to help enterprises improve authorization and conversion rates, expand across markets, simplify payment operations, manage cost and risk, and deliver better local customer experiences. You will also scale your impact by developing reusable APAC-specific assets, reference architectures, and sales plays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex enterprise customer engagements from discovery through solution design, implementation planning, and measurement of business impact across Managed Payments, Adaptive Pricing, OCS, and local payment methods.
  • Advise customers on scalable payments architecture, including payment orchestration, multi-currency flows, cards, wallets, local payment methods, fraud and risk systems, and money-movement rails.
  • Conduct deep discovery with business and technical stakeholders, develop solution scopes and reference architectures, and guide trade-offs across conversion, authorization, cost, risk, customer experience, and implementation complexity.
  • Act as an APAC payments thought leader by bringing regional market insight including cross-border and local payment-method considerations to customers, sales teams, and Stripe’s product and engineering organizations.
  • Scale the broader organization through reusable APAC assets, customer workshops, coaching on strategic opportunities, and collaboration with internal teams and customers across the region; travel approximately 25% as needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in payments, fintech, financial services, or a related technology industry, including designing payment solutions or financial architectures for enterprise customers.
  • Deep knowledge of payment flows and payments architecture, including cards, wallets, local payment methods, multi-currency payments, payment orchestration, fraud and risk systems, money movement, and relevant ISO payment standards.
  • Experience advising large B2B and/or B2C enterprises on payment modernization, checkout optimisation, conversion and authorization improvement, cost optimisation, network compliance, or processing reliability.
  • Strong understanding of the APAC payments landscape and cross-border payment considerations, ideally including experience supporting Greater China, Southeast Asia, and/or ANZ.
  • Strong project management, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to work independently through ambiguity; professional fluency in English and Business Mandarin to conduct business and technical conversations with regional customers and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe or integrating RESTful APIs into web or mobile applications.
  • Experience with Optimised Checkout, payment orchestration, adaptive payment-routing approaches, or checkout-conversion optimisation.
  • Experience with online payments, marketplaces, subscriptions, platforms, or multi-party money movement.
  • Experience working in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or payments-specialist role.
  • Experience building a new regional function, creating repeatable operating practices, or succeeding as an early in-region hire within a globally distributed organisation.

How we build

We are a collaborative, intensely driven team operating at the highest level of performance. This isn’t a place for the complacent. It’s where ambition makes ideas a reality and careers accelerate at full speed. Here's what you'll find if you join us:

Ethics and compliance are at the center of what we do.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards of ethics and regulatory compliance, as we know customer trust is hard earned and easily lost. See our Code of Conduct here.

We operate with an extreme sense of urgency.

The world's not slowing down, and neither are we. Working here is intense, urgent, and fast-moving by design. We run toward hard problems and push through all-out sprints for purposeful work that makes real-world impact in weeks, not years.

We believe in doing more with less.

Our hiring and promotions aren't about who's led the biggest team, but who's led lean teams to big results. We care about execution, not title. Prioritizing delivery over hierarchy helps us operate more like a start-up, even at our scale.

Bureaucracy won't slow you down.

We're builders. We eliminate barriers to direct feedback and are allergic to unnecessary processes. It may sound simple, but time is too valuable to waste - for our teams and especially for our customers.

Expectations are high; excellence is rewarded.

Insane Customer Focus

Insane Customer Focus

Our customers are why we exist. We listen to them, design for their needs, and aim to make our user experience elegant and intuitive.

We put what's best for customers at the center of decision-making, bringing them the best in technology coupled with real value. When there are customer pain points, we fix them quickly.

High Performance

High Performance

We operate with extreme urgency. We push for progress without compromising quality-and when something is broken, we fix it. We're driven by impact and pride ourselves in our ability to be nimble and quickly adjust our strategy when presented with new information. Friction and obstacles don't deter us from pursuing what's truly important.

Safety Always

Safety Always

Trust is hard earned and easily lost. We take responsibility for our customers' finances seriously. We are compliant, approach risks thoughtfully, and never compromise trust for speed.

One Robinhood

One Robinhood

We're all invested in the same mission. We earn each other's trust through honesty, inclusion, and respect - because finger-pointing never does the trick. We invite contrary perspectives, support each other, and debate with energy and kindness. Once decisions are made, we move in unison with ownership and accountability, powered by the thrill of building something great together.

Participation is Power

Participation is Power

We level the playing field. We started a movement, breaking barriers so everyone—not just the wealthy—can access the financial system. The elites always find a way to get nicer things, which means our job to "democratize finance for all" may never be complete — which is what makes it so fun.

First-Principles Thinking

First-Principles Thinking

When we want to lead, we lead. We're innovators and problem solvers. Rather than iterating on the past, we start from first principles, questioning assumptions and finding creative solutions from square one. We use data, empirical truth, and experiments to inform decisions. Our bold bets often make us a first mover, and we do what's right for customers - even if it hasn't been done before.

Lean and Disciplined

Lean and Disciplined

We do more with less. Constraint drives us to innovate through scalable technology-not excess resources. We set ambitious goals, benchmark performance, and weigh trade offs before changing course. We respect each other's time by reducing toil and bureaucracy. And by keeping costs low and efficiency high, we deliver exceptional value customers can't find anywhere else.

You'll work closely with software development teams to define quality standards, develop test strategies, and drive software quality improvements through technical expertise and process enhancements.

Responsibilities

  • Own software quality for Terminal device software components, including firmware and the device operating system, and ensure software quality targets are met for customers.   • Strong leadership, communication, ownership, and influencing skills to drive quality improvements across teams, along with excellent verbal and written English communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge of embedded systems, real-time operating systems, and firmware development
  • Familiarity with payment processing systems or financial technology
  • Track record of mentoring junior team members on technical skills and test design

This isn't a maintenance seat: you're inheriting a real backlog of structural work (an account hierarchy rebuild, a new opportunity/product data model, a lead-routing redesign, and a new customer lifecycle model), plus day-to-day ownership of the tools that run our revenue motion.

You'll partner with our RevOps Ops & Analytics Lead, who sets the architecture on major structural work. Everything else — routing tweaks, workflow changes, field and flow fixes — you design and ship yourself, with a fast sign-off loop instead of a committee. You bring the hands-on tool expertise that keeps the architecture honest; we bring a stack that's actually changing over the next year, not one you're just keeping the lights on for.

We're AI-first and mean it operationally: you'll use AI daily to build faster, and you'll partner with Engineering to replace repetitive manual GTM work with agents.

What You'll Own

  • Salesforce building: fields, flows, validation rules, page layouts, routing configuration

  • Operational workflows across the full GTM stack — Salesforce, LeanData, Chili Piper, HubSpot, and beyond

  • Partnering with Engineering to automate repetitive GTM work with AI agents

  • Day-to-day requests from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance — keeping data clean and issues resolved fast

  • Your own designs for day-to-day and recurring changes, with a quick sign-off, not a lengthy review

  • Data inputs supporting Finance's forecasting and revenue models

  • Judgment on when a build needs an outside specialist

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain fields, flows, validation rules, and layouts across Salesforce

  • Draft and own routing and workflow configuration across the stack, with sign-off from the GTM Ops & Analytics Lead on anything nontrivial

  • Lead execution on major system redesigns: account hierarchy, opportunity and product data model, lead routing, customer lifecycle

  • Identify repetitive, rules-based GTM workflows with Engineering and build agents to automate them

  • Use AI tools daily in your own build process — and stand behind everything you ship

  • Resolve requests from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance — field changes, workflow fixes, routing and scheduling issues, data cleanup

What We're Looking For

  • Highly AI-capable: you use AI tools daily to build and move faster, and you can stand behind every output

  • 4–7+ years building and maintaining Salesforce and a broader GTM stack (LeanData, Chili Piper, HubSpot, Hex, or equivalents)

  • You want ownership of a real stack, not a seat reporting on one — comfortable owning execution and proposing your own designs for day-to-day work

  • Strong communicator who flags status and risk before being asked

  • Collaborative — brings solutions and pressure-tests designs without needing to own the overall strategy

  • Good judgment about when a build needs to go to a specialist

  • Comfortable in Hex (or similar BI tool) is a plus — this role doesn't own reporting, but occasional dashboard support is welcome

About BIT:


BIT (formerly Matrixport) is a global digital asset financial services and infrastructure group. Headquartered in Singapore and founded in 2019, BIT bridges traditional finance and digital assets through governance-driven financial services and technology.


The firm manages over US$7 billion in assets and facilitates more than US$7 billion in monthly trading volume. BIT offers services including custody, trading, asset and wealth management, liquidity and financing solutions, and tokenised real-world assets (RWA), serving institutional and professional investors globally.


BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan.


For more information, visit www.bit.com


Why Join Us:


At BIT, we tackle complex problems as a team. We encourage openness and promote transparency, respect, and inclusivity. Every team member is valued and has a voice that can be heard. We are always in search of intellectually curious and entrepreneurial individuals who are keen on making an impact in the crypto ecosystem and in building a better product for the next one billion users.


About the Role:


We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Talent Acquisition Manager to support our hiring initiatives across multiple functions and regions. This role will manage end-to-end recruitment, drive talent pipeline building, optimise hiring processes, and contribute to employer branding — all in support of our continued business growth.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Develop and implement recruiting strategies to attract and retain top talent across all levels of the organization
  • Source candidates through various channels such as job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals
  • Conduct interviews, assess candidate qualifications, and make recommendations to hiring managers
  • Collaborate with department heads to understand hiring needs and develop job descriptions
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from job posting to offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain relationships with external partners including recruitment agencies and universities
  • Lead high-volume, high-quality internship recruitment programs, sourcing top-tier talent from reputable universities and competitive graduate pipelines
  • Evaluate and optimize recruitment processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related discipline
  • Minimum 5 years of end-to-end recruitment experience, preferably within tech, fintech, crypto, or digital assets industries
  • Strong knowledge of talent markets and hiring practices across multiple regions, particularly in Asia-Pacific
  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment across multiple functions and seniority levels from junior hires to senior leadership
  • Demonstrated experience running structured internship hiring programs at scale — including sourcing from top-tier universities, managing high application volumes, and maintaining a high bar for candidate quality
  • Proficient in recruitment platforms and ATS tools, with strong data analysis and reporting skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Proficiency in both English and Mandarin preferred given the regional scope of the role

Headquartered in Singapore and founded in 2019, BIT bridges traditional finance and digital assets through governance-driven financial services and technology. The firm manages over US$7 billion in assets and facilitates more than US$7 billion in monthly trading volume. BIT offers services including custody, trading, asset and wealth management, liquidity and financing solutions, and tokenised real-world assets (RWA), serving institutional and professional investors globally. BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan. For more information, visit www.bit.com



About the Role：At BIT, we come together as a dynamic team to tackle exciting challenges head-on, creating an environment bursting with openness, transparency, and inclusivity. Every graduate is a vital part of our mission, and your ideas will always be valued. We’re searching for passionate, intellectually curious, and entrepreneurial individuals ready to make a real impact in the crypto ecosystem and help create innovative products for the next billion users.



Responsibilities：



  • Core System Architecture: Design and implement the architecture for core systems including trading, accounting, and clearing & settlement, ensuring data consistency and fund security.
  • External Institution Integration: Lead system integration with Clearing Brokers and Execution Venues.
  • Accounting & Reconciliation System: Build a broker-level accounting and end-of-day reconciliation system, ensuring data alignment with clearing parties, upstream brokers, and regulatory reporting.
  • Margin Financing & Options Derivatives: Design and iterate risk engines (margin and liquidation logic) and deposit/withdrawal/transfer flows to ensure fund safety.

Qualifications：



  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of backend / distributed systems development experience, including 3+ years of core system experience at a securities firm or exchange.



Required Skills：



  • Familiar with the full order lifecycle and OMS/EMS design.
  • Proficient in the FIX protocol and able to independently complete FIX Engine integration.
  • Deep understanding of clearing, settlement, and accounting mechanisms, with hands-on experience designing and implementing broker-level accounting systems.
  • Strong engineering skills and good communication skills in both Chinese and English.



Preferred Skills：



  • Experience building a core system from 0 to 1 at an offshore securities firm.
  • Knowledge of open-source/commercial components related to accounting or FIX.

Iron by MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

Iron, a MoonPay company, is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


About the Role

As Head of Strategic Accounts at Iron, you will own and lead the post-sale commercial relationship with our most important enterprise customers. This is a leadership role: you will set the strategy for how Iron retains, deepens, and grows its strategic book, build and lead the team that delivers it, and act as the senior executive partner to the founders, C-suite, and product leaders building on Iron’s financial infrastructure.

You will be accountable for net revenue retention and expansion across the strategic portfolio, and for translating direct customer engagement into influence over Iron’s product, commercial, and platform direction. You will operate as the senior voice of the customer inside the business and a senior representative of Iron to the market.

Reporting into commercial leadership, you will sit at the intersection of customer strategy and company strategy - shaping not just how individual accounts grow, but how Iron builds the account management function as it scales.

What You’ll Own

  • Function: Define and run Iron’s strategic account management model - operating cadence, playbooks, segmentation, and success metrics - from the ground up.

  • Revenue: Carry the number for net revenue retention and expansion across the strategic book, with clear accountability for the commercial trajectory of the portfolio.

  • Executive relationships: Own the most senior relationships across our strategic customers, from founders and C-suite to product and operations leadership.

  • Influence: Be the senior conduit between strategic customers and Iron’s Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams, shaping roadmap and commercial strategy with first-hand market signal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set strategy: Define and execute the strategic account management strategy across Iron’s most important enterprise customers, aligned to company revenue and product goals.

  • Own executive relationships: Serve as the senior partner to founders, executives, product leaders, and operations teams, building trusted, board-visible relationships.

  • Drive retention and expansion: Take ownership of net revenue retention, expansion, wallet share, and transaction volume across the portfolio through proactive, commercially-led account management.

  • Lead commercial discussions: Lead and oversee complex commercial negotiations, contract renewals, pricing conversations, and expansion deals across strategic accounts.

  • Run executive business reviews: Lead senior business reviews with customers, providing strategic guidance and surfacing opportunities for deeper collaboration and co-development.

  • Be the voice of the customer: Synthesise customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive insight into actionable direction for Product, Engineering, and Leadership; influence the roadmap with evidence from the field.

  • Shape product direction: Partner with Product and Engineering to validate new features, test concepts, and lead customer-driven and co-development initiatives with strategic partners.

  • Own account health: Establish how Iron monitors account health, engagement, and adoption trends; design retention and engagement programmes that pre-empt churn risk and unlock growth.

  • Own competitive intelligence: Develop a deep view of the competitive landscape - where rivals win, lose, and position against Iron - and feed it back into product strategy, positioning, and commercial execution.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and Leadership to ensure exceptional customer outcomes and a joined-up commercial approach.

  • Represent Iron: Act as a senior representative of Iron with strategic customers, partners, and the wider market.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in Strategic Account Management, Strategic Partnerships, Customer Success, or Commercial leadership, including a track record of leading and building teams.

  • Proven success owning and growing a strategic book of business at scale - driving retention, expansion, and net revenue growth across enterprise accounts.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers and operational stakeholders alike, including at founder and C-suite level.

  • Strong commercial leadership instincts and a track record of identifying and closing growth opportunities within strategic accounts.

  • Experience translating customer requirements and market intelligence into product and commercial strategy that leadership acts on.

  • Deep understanding of payments, fintech infrastructure, stablecoins, treasury, banking, or adjacent financial technology ecosystems.

  • Excellent communication, executive stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Comfort leading the most strategic customer conversations, executive business reviews, and complex commercial negotiations.

  • Highly organised, proactive, and able to set direction and operate independently in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • Naturally curious about customer behaviour, market dynamics, and competitive trends - and energised by shaping both customer strategy and product direction at a high-growth infrastructure company.

Why This Role Matters

Iron’s strategic customers are where the company’s growth, product direction, and market reputation are won. This role owns that surface end to end - the relationships, the revenue, the team, and the feedback loop into the platform. It is a rare opportunity to build a function, not just run a book, at a company defining the next generation of money-movement infrastructure.
