Backed by Circle, Coinbase, Dragonfly, Wintermute, and Cumberland, we're a small team solving hard problems at the intersection of crypto and global payments.

The Role
Codex is scaling its client base rapidly across APAC — and the operational infrastructure that keeps those clients active, funded, and trading needs to scale with it. As the Payment Operations Manager, you'll own the full post-onboarding client experience: treasury and settlement operations, client activation, and the processes that turn a newly onboarded account into a consistently trading one.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll be doing the work yourself — moving money, resolving settlement issues, running penny tests, and staying close to clients — while building the systems and playbooks that allow the function to scale beyond you. You'll work closely with the trading and account management team.

 

Responsibilities

Treasury & Settlement Operations

  • Manage intraday treasury balances across fiat and crypto accounts, ensuring settlement capacity is available for active clients across APAC trading hours

  • Oversee end-to-end settlement for client trades — tracking traded-and-settled vs traded-and-not-settled positions, resolving delayed or failed settlements, and coordinating with banking and crypto counterparties on exceptions

  • Handle escalations for rejected or undelivered wire transfers; coordinate with banks and payment providers to trace and resolve stuck payments

  • Monitor and reconcile fund movements across accounts (fiat rails, on-chain networks), flagging discrepancies and maintaining clean records

Client Onboarding & Activation

  • Own the operational side of client onboarding: penny testing new fiat and crypto accounts, configuring counterparties, whitelisting wallets, and coordinating demo calls

  • Build and implement client activation strategies — structured playbooks that take a newly KYB-cleared account from zero to first trade as quickly as possible

  • Serve as the senior operational point of contact for APAC clients through onboarding and early activation, setting expectations and resolving friction before it becomes churn

Process Building

  • Document and systematise current operational processes — identifying what's manual, what's fragile, and where automation or tooling would have the most impact

  • Work with Engineering and Product to translate operational pain points into product improvements

  • Build the operational infrastructure — runbooks, escalation protocols, handover standards — that allows the team to grow without quality degrading


What We're Looking For

  • 6–10 years of experience in payment operations, trading operations, or client operations at a crypto OTC desk, exchange, or digital asset firm

  • Hands-on experience with treasury management and settlement across fiat and crypto rails — you've moved money, resolved failures, and understand what goes wrong and why

  • Track record of building and implementing client activation processes, not just executing within ones someone else built

  • Strong client-facing skills: able to manage relationships with institutional and fintech clients professionally, even when resolving operational issues

  • Comfortable doing individual contributor work at a senior level — this is not a people management role, it's a builder role


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at a company scaling its APAC client base rapidly

  • Understanding of crypto market microstructure and OTC pricing mechanics

  • Experience with account management : understanding why clients churn, what it takes to bring them back, and running structured reactivation campaigns

  • Experience maintaining customer success processes that create consistency across the client experience — from first trade through to high-volume, recurring flow

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

 

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

Context & Purpose of the Role

The Total Rewards team is entering a high-intensity period: a year-end compensation review cycle, active benchmarking work, custom bonus plan reviews, and a rising volume of analytical deliverables supporting executive and board-level reporting. To protect bandwidth and quality, we are bringing in a mid-level contractor to work closely with and under the supervision of our Paris-based Compensation & Benefits Expert, reporting directly to the Head of Total Rewards. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone with genuine C&B grounding who can work with light direction once context is set, and who understands what makes compensation data credible.

What You'll Be Working On

Year-End Compensation Review

  • Support data preparation and validation for the annual merit, performance, and bonus review cycles: building and maintaining population files, tracking timelines, and flagging data quality issues before they become problems.

  • Work closely with the C&B Expert on modelling and scenario analysis (budget impact, distribution curves, outlier identification), producing clean, auditable outputs.

  • Contribute to salary budget modelling and refresh of salary structures using latest market data, including updates to merit matrices.

  • Coordinate with HRBPs and People Ops on data collection and sign-off workflows to keep the cycle on track.

Analytical Work for Board & Executive Reporting

  • On direction from the Head of Total Rewards, carry out the underlying data pulls, analysis, and cross-checks to populate compensation metrics and summaries used in board and executive slides.

  • Produce clean, presentation-ready tables and data panels with accurate footnotes and sourcing, so outputs can be directly incorporated into slide decks.

Bonus Plan Design Reviews

  • This contractor may provide support to the C&B Expert and Head of Total Rewards during bonus plan reviews, including

    • Preparing and updating slide decks to support design discussions.

    • Running employee data analyses and refreshing payout range modelling for plan redesigns.

    • Using AI tools to update bonus plan rules documentation in Word as designs evolve, ensuring plan write-ups accurately reflect agreed changes ahead of final review.

Ad Hoc C&B Support

  • Support the C&B Expert on operational tasks: Workday data uploads, equity grant list preparation and validation, and patent premium tracking.

  • Support the C&B Expert and Head of Total Rewards on ad hoc projects. Examples may include aspects of job architecture and related market benchmarking analytics, pay equity & equity grant modelling.

What We're Looking For

Requirement

Experience

4 years+ in Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards. C&B-specific experience is required; broader HR analytics backgrounds without meaningful C&B exposure will not be considered.

Education

Degree in a quantitative discipline preferred (e.g. Finance, Economics, Statistics, or equivalent).

Excel & Modelling

Advanced Excel is non-negotiable: pivot tables, scenario modelling, audit-proof workbooks, and confident handling of large datasets.

Benchmarking Tools

Hands-on experience with Radford or Mercer Comptryx strongly preferred. Familiarity with the mechanics of job matching and market data interpretation is expected.

Workday

Experience using Workday for compensation cycle management is a strong plus.

Stakeholder Exposure

Experience working with or supporting stakeholders outside France — whether across European markets or globally — is a plus.

Autonomy

Able to work from a defined brief with minimal hand-holding. Asks the right clarifying questions early; doesn't need ongoing supervision once context is clear.

Languages

Fluent English required (working language of the team). French strongly preferred — most day-to-day collaborators are Paris-based.

Tools

Comfort with AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini) for document drafting and workflow efficiency is welcome.

What This Role Is (and Isn't)

This is not a strategy or design role — Ledger already has senior expertise in-house for that. What we need is someone who executes cleanly and independently at the analytical and operational level, and who brings enough C&B literacy to produce outputs that don't need to be re-done. You will be working on real, high-stakes deliverables from day one.

About Chainlink

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About The Role

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Institutional Data Management, you own the commercial case for bringing high-value proprietary data onchain. You are the narrative and product marketing lead for institutional data providers and index owners, positioning Chainlink so they can reach onchain consumers without disrupting their existing licensing models or commercial structures.

This role runs on the distribution economics of financial data, a distinct institutional business with its own buyers and entrenched commercial structures. You own the segment's value chain, personas, and incumbent map, and the commercial case for the onchain consumers on the other side of the market. You lead product marketing for solutions like DataLink, showing how Chainlink respects institutional requirements while opening new onchain use cases and explore opportunities to shape and develop new data offerings to take to market. The goal is to make Chainlink the default reference layer for institutional data onchain.

Your Impact

  • Map the Data Value Chain: Document the end-to-end workflow for institutional data, from proprietary sources to on-chain smart contracts, and identify the commercial motivations for every participant.
  • Craft Distribution Narratives: Own the positioning for proprietary data distribution, making the commercial case for providers to publish onchain and for onchain consumers to adopt institutional data.
  • Develop Canonical Content: Create the "Product Marketing Playbook” and strategic inputs that fuel the content, events, and PR teams, ensuring a coherent and authoritative voice across all data-related touchpoints.
  • Competitive Governance: Maintain a definitive landscape of direct competitors, incumbents, and build-it-yourself alternatives, ensuring our GTM teams are equipped to differentiate Chainlink’s data solutions.
  • Shape Pricing & Packaging: Partner with Product and Sales to influence the commercial structures of our data offerings, ensuring they align with how institutional data is bought and sold.

Requirements

  • At least 6 years of experience in product marketing or strategy, with deep fluency in institutional data licensing, distribution, and commercial structures.
  • Proven ability to translate complex data workflows and technical distribution mechanics into clear, business-focused value propositions.
  • Understands how institutional data providers operate and what they require to publish onchain, and how the buy-side consumes that data onchain, from DeFi protocols today to other institutions over time.
  • Can build positioning that speaks to data providers' commercial realities, not just the technical capability (index providers, rating agencies, reference data vendors).
  • Proven experience owning GTM strategy and execution for successful platform or infrastructure launches.
  • Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to act as the "go-to" marketing lead for a complex category.

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior role at a major data vendor
  • Technical background or strong comfort working with data-heavy products and API-based distribution.
  • Familiarity with onchain data infrastructure, oracles, or how DeFi protocols consume external data.

You’ll own the commercial story of how global banks and corporate treasuries transition from legacy fiat rails to a future-state settlement involving stablecoins and tokenized deposits. This role is not about marketing a single product; it is about owning the end-to-end settlement workflow and the market truth for this segment.

You will sit at the intersection of institutional finance and decentralized infrastructure, helping major financial actors understand how Chainlink’s platform solves complex payment legs and liquidity management. You will work closely with product, GTM, and content teams to translate technical capabilities into "buyer truth," ensuring that our messaging resonates with the world’s largest financial institutions and payment networks.

  • Market Intelligence: Act as the "eyes and ears" of the market, synthesizing signals from treasury and liquidity buyers to influence the product roadmap and keep Chainlink ahead of emerging trends in tokenized cash.
  • Strategic Execution: Lead the GTM strategy for new solutions in the payments portfolio, ensuring every launch is strategically sound, flawlessly delivered, and measured against adoption and pipeline influence.
  • Drive Sales Enablement: Build canonical sales plays, proposal libraries, and "battle cards" that empower GTM teams to win Tier 1 customer deals without requiring reactive, custom work.

Requirements

  • At least 6+ years of experience in product marketing, specifically within institutional payments, settlement, or corporate treasury workflows
  • Strong messaging and positioning skills, with a proven ability to craft compelling narratives for institutional decision-makers
  • Deep fluency in settlement rails, including an understanding of fiat rails, stablecoins, and tokenized deposits
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across product, engineering, and sales teams to turn technical roadmaps into "buyer truth."
  • Experience owning the GTM strategy and execution for multiple successful product or feature launches in the B2B SaaS or enterprise infrastructure space

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior experience at a global bank, major payments network, or institutional treasury platform
  • Familiarity with the blockchain ecosystem, particularly regarding players in the payments sector
  • Experience in a globally distributed, remote-first organization

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Rain is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our onchain surface — the blockchain layer that everything else at Rain depends on. Stablecoins only work as real-world money if the onchain side is fast, safe, and invisible: collateral held in contracts, settlement across chains, custody and wallet architecture, and the asset and network coverage our partners need to operate globally. This role owns that.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the directly responsible PM for onchain end to end: smart contracts and protocol design, chain and asset integrations, settlement and treasury flows, and the infrastructure underneath it all. You'll work closely with engineering, security, compliance, legal, and directly with our fintech, neobank, and institutional partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the roadmap for Rain's onchain product — smart contracts, chain and asset coverage, settlement, and payments — and drive it end to end

  • Partner deeply with engineering on protocol and infrastructure tradeoffs (contract architecture and upgradeability, collateralization and liquidation logic, node/RPC reliability, gas and fee strategy, bridging and cross-chain messaging) and translate them into partner-facing product decisions

  • Decide which chains, assets, and stablecoins Rain supports and when — build the framework for those calls across liquidity, security, cost, partner demand, compliance considerations, and regulatory exposure

  • Drive the security bar for onchain work — audits, monitoring, incident response, and the operational guardrails that go with holding real value onchain

  • Translate complex protocol and blockchain infrastructure into intuitive product surfaces and clear partner-facing documentation

  • Gather feedback directly from partners, distill it into sharp prioritization, and push the team toward the highest-leverage work

  • Measure ruthlessly, iterate quickly, and set a bar others want to work to

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products from zero-to-one through scale at a product-led company with a strong engineering culture and high bar for quality

  • Deep, hands-on blockchain fluency — you've shipped onchain products and can reason unaided about EVM and Solana mechanics (and other chains), smart contract design and upgrade patterns, gas economics, bridging models, and other onchain tradeoffs

  • Exceptional product judgment and analytical rigor — you're someone others describe as one of the sharpest PMs they've worked with, and you consistently raise the bar for the people around you

  • A senior, autonomous operator who can define the problem, drive the plan, and own the outcome without needing close direction

  • Sound instincts on onchain security and risk: you know where value gets lost, you push for audits and monitoring before incidents rather than after, and you can weigh a shipping deadline against a real risk without flinching

  • Strong technical fluency beyond the chain itself (APIs, distributed systems, payments and ledger design) and the instinct to pull on technical threads yourself rather than defer to engineering

  • Genuinely excited to live in the details — you believe product quality is won in the specifics and are energized by the work to get them right

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can operate with sophisticated external partners and internal engineering teams with equal ease

  • Proven ability to ship quickly, measure adoption, and iterate in a fast-moving environment

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY

  • Experience with stablecoin issuance, onchain lending or collateralized credit, or tokenized asset products

  • Background at a protocol, L1/L2, wallet, custodian, or onchain infrastructure company

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, Tron, Bitcoin L2s) and multi-chain operations at scale

  • Experience with payments, card issuing, or cross-border fintech products

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape around digital assets and custody

  • Previous startup or hypergrowth environment experience

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy, and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Mission
To advance the adoption of the Walrus Protocol – a Verifiable Data Platform for AI Builders

Vision
To create a foundation for AI builders to store and manage their data, making that data persistent, portable, and under their control across apps, providers, and agents.

Walrus Foundation is looking for a Staff Product Designer to define and own the product experience for Walrus.

Walrus is infrastructure for developers, and designing infrastructure products requires a particular kind of product thinking. Users need to navigate technical concepts, understand system state, work with large amounts of information, configure resources, diagnose problems, and take actions that can have real consequences for their data, storage, or spend.

You'll partner closely with product and engineering from the earliest stages of discovery through implementation. You won't receive finished requirements and turn them into screens. You'll help determine which problems matter, investigate how developers actually work, challenge assumptions, prototype and test potential solutions, and ultimately define how developers experience Walrus.

As a Staff designer, you'll also establish the systems and standards that allow the product to scale. You'll think beyond individual features to create consistent interaction patterns, reusable components, and product principles that make the entire Walrus experience more coherent over time.

What you'll do

  • Own the Walrus product experience. Define and evolve the end-to-end developer experience across Walrus's product surfaces and key workflows.

  • Lead discovery with product and engineering. Help frame problems before the team jumps to solutions, identify unanswered questions, and determine what evidence we need before committing to build.

  • Bring developers directly into the design process. Conduct lightweight developer interviews and usability tests, put prototypes in front of real users, and synthesize findings into decisions the team can act on.

  • Design complex technical workflows. Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs for experiences involving dense data, system state, configuration, resource management, and high-consequence actions.

  • Influence product direction. Bring a strong point of view on what Walrus should build—not just how features should look—and constructively challenge product and engineering assumptions when needed.

  • Build Walrus's design system. Establish and maintain shared components, interaction patterns, and product principles that create consistency and allow the product surface to grow without fragmenting.

  • Benchmark the market. Regularly tear down comparable developer and infrastructure products to understand established patterns, identify opportunities, and avoid reinventing solved problems.

  • Stay close through implementation. Partner with engineering throughout development, review what ships against the intended experience, catch problems early, and incorporate requirements and feedback from partners such as Legal.

  • Raise the design bar. Establish what excellent developer-product design looks like for Walrus and help create the practices that maintain that standard as the organization grows.

What we're looking for

  • 8-10 years of product design experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical products.

  • A portfolio demonstrating ownership of shipped developer tools, cloud/infrastructure products, consoles, dashboards, or similarly complex technical products.

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify technically sophisticated workflows without removing the control or information expert users need.

  • Strong interaction-design skills across data-heavy interfaces, tables, configuration, complex states, progressive disclosure, permissions, errors, and high-consequence actions.

  • Experience independently identifying and framing product problems rather than primarily executing against predefined requirements.

  • A track record of influencing product strategy and roadmap decisions through design.

  • Strong qualitative research instincts and experience incorporating lightweight user research and usability testing into day-to-day product work.

  • Experience creating or significantly evolving design systems and reusable interaction patterns.

  • Strong partnership with engineering and a willingness to remain involved through implementation and design QA.

  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to disagree constructively with senior product and engineering partners.

  • Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving technical environment.

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Rain is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our onchain surface — the blockchain layer that everything else at Rain depends on. Stablecoins only work as real-world money if the onchain side is fast, safe, and invisible: collateral held in contracts, settlement across chains, custody and wallet architecture, and the asset and network coverage our partners need to operate globally. This role owns that.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the directly responsible PM for onchain end to end: smart contracts and protocol design, chain and asset integrations, settlement and treasury flows, and the infrastructure underneath it all. You'll work closely with engineering, security, compliance, legal, and directly with our fintech, neobank, and institutional partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the roadmap for Rain's onchain product — smart contracts, chain and asset coverage, settlement, and payments — and drive it end to end

  • Partner deeply with engineering on protocol and infrastructure tradeoffs (contract architecture and upgradeability, collateralization and liquidation logic, node/RPC reliability, gas and fee strategy, bridging and cross-chain messaging) and translate them into partner-facing product decisions

  • Decide which chains, assets, and stablecoins Rain supports and when — build the framework for those calls across liquidity, security, cost, partner demand, compliance considerations, and regulatory exposure

  • Drive the security bar for onchain work — audits, monitoring, incident response, and the operational guardrails that go with holding real value onchain

  • Translate complex protocol and blockchain infrastructure into intuitive product surfaces and clear partner-facing documentation

  • Gather feedback directly from partners, distill it into sharp prioritization, and push the team toward the highest-leverage work

  • Measure ruthlessly, iterate quickly, and set a bar others want to work to

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products from zero-to-one through scale at a product-led company with a strong engineering culture and high bar for quality

  • Deep, hands-on blockchain fluency — you've shipped onchain products and can reason unaided about EVM and Solana mechanics (and other chains), smart contract design and upgrade patterns, gas economics, bridging models, and other onchain tradeoffs

  • Exceptional product judgment and analytical rigor — you're someone others describe as one of the sharpest PMs they've worked with, and you consistently raise the bar for the people around you

  • A senior, autonomous operator who can define the problem, drive the plan, and own the outcome without needing close direction

  • Sound instincts on onchain security and risk: you know where value gets lost, you push for audits and monitoring before incidents rather than after, and you can weigh a shipping deadline against a real risk without flinching

  • Strong technical fluency beyond the chain itself (APIs, distributed systems, payments and ledger design) and the instinct to pull on technical threads yourself rather than defer to engineering

  • Genuinely excited to live in the details — you believe product quality is won in the specifics and are energized by the work to get them right

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can operate with sophisticated external partners and internal engineering teams with equal ease

  • Proven ability to ship quickly, measure adoption, and iterate in a fast-moving environment

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY

  • Experience with stablecoin issuance, onchain lending or collateralized credit, or tokenized asset products

  • Background at a protocol, L1/L2, wallet, custodian, or onchain infrastructure company

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, Tron, Bitcoin L2s) and multi-chain operations at scale

  • Experience with payments, card issuing, or cross-border fintech products

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape around digital assets and custody

  • Previous startup or hypergrowth environment experience

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

About the Role:

Responsibilities

  • Lead the card-issuing risk control product architecture: Own the full lifecycle of the card issuing payment risk control product, building an end-to-end risk platform encompassing real-time authorization interception rules, static/dynamic limit systems, and abnormal transaction alerting mechanisms.
  • Optimize rules and reduce false-positive rates: Continuously refine risk engine rules and threshold configurations to improve fraud detection quality while significantly reducing false-positive (false-decline) rates, balancing risk control red lines against payment approval rates.
  • Build post-transaction monitoring and loss-prevention tools: Establish scalable post-transaction monitoring and manual review workflows; design authorization holds, offline force-debit protection, and settlement-cycle FX slippage prevention mechanisms.
  • Design tiered and scenario-based controls: Tailor differentiated limit controls, 3DS verification strategies, and risk protection mechanisms for different user tiers, card types, and suspicious payment scenarios.
  • Collaborate on risk operations and case efficiency: Work closely with the risk operations team to optimize alert routing, case management, and review/unblocking workflows, improving investigation and processing efficiency.
  • Interface with card networks and BIN sponsors on compliance: Partner with data and engineering teams to ensure the stability of millisecond-level decision engines, ensuring the card portfolio's fraud rate complies with Visa/Mastercard and BIN Sponsor compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Enable AI and advanced analytics: Explore and apply AI and machine learning models to improve detection accuracy for complex fraud rings and anomalous transactions, reducing manual operational costs.


Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above, with 3+ years of experience in payment risk control, card issuing systems, or digital banking product management.
  • Experience in product design related to card issuing risk control / real-time authorization interception / limit management / loss prevention (strongly relevant experience preferred).
  • Understanding of the fundamentals of how crypto operates; experience with crypto cards or Web3 payments is a plus.

Professional Skills

  • 3+ years of experience as a product manager in payment risk control, card issuing systems, or digital banking, with experience building issuing-side real-time authorization interception, transaction monitoring, or anti-fraud systems.
  • Ability to plan and configure risk detection logic, static/dynamic limit matrices, frequency rules, identity verification strategies, and risk thresholds.
  • Strong data-driven mindset, proficient with SQL and data analysis tools to investigate anomalous transaction signals, evaluate rule performance, and optimize false-positive rates.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with risk operations, compliance, data analytics, and engineering teams to drive complex projects to completion.
  • Experience building automated, scalable risk control systems within a strict risk and compliance environment, with the ability to balance interception rates, operational processing efficiency, and user payment experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building card issuing systems or integrating with third-party CaaS (Card-as-a-Service) providers.
  • Experience building crypto cards or crypto on/off-ramp solutions.
  • Experience building a card issuing risk control engine or risk case management system from 0 to 1.
  • Familiarity with early chargeback-prevention networks such as Ethoca / Verifi, and card network dispute/chargeback handling processes.

About BIT:

BIT (formerly Matrixport) is a global digital asset financial services and infrastructure group. Headquartered in Singapore and founded in 2019, BIT bridges traditional finance and digital assets through governance-driven financial services and technology.

The firm manages over US$7 billion in assets and facilitates more than US$7 billion in monthly trading volume. BIT offers services including custody, trading, asset and wealth management, liquidity and financing solutions, and tokenised real-world assets (RWA), serving institutional and professional investors globally.

BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan.


For more information, visit www.bit.com


Why Join Us:

At BIT, we tackle complex problems as a team. We encourage openness and promote transparency, respect, and inclusivity. Every team member is valued and has a voice that can be heard. We are always in search of intellectually curious and entrepreneurial individuals who are keen on making an impact in the crypto ecosystem and in building a better product for the next one billion users.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Head of KYC to lead the KYC department; act as coverage during their absence;
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for client onboarding across all business lines, providing guidance and mentorship;
  • Act as the subject matter expert and primary liaison for counterparty account openings, periodic reviews/trigger event reviews across all business lines;
  • Lead pre and ongoing counterparty due diligence and its periodic refresh cycles; Verify KYC/CDD documents, assess AML/CFT questionnaire completeness, conduct risk assessments, and provide clear recommendations to senior management for approval;
  • Prepare comprehensive KYC/CDD files and respond promptly to counterparties' AML/CFT questionnaires to facilitate mutual onboarding/periodic reviews;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify process gaps, control risks, and implement process improvement initiatives;
  • Take ownership of Counterparty Due Diligence and its periodic refresh cycles;
  • Oversee ongoing monitoring activities, including escalated name screening alerts and periodic client reviews;
  • Maintain and update compliance control lists, logs, and documentation;
  • Act as an ambassador of Matrixport, ensuring professionalism, regulatory compliance, and excellent client experience;
  • Support ad-hoc compliance projects and initiatives as required.



Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of KYC/AML experience, with proven leadership or team management experience preferred
  • Strong knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and client due diligence processes
  • Experience or strong interest in virtual assets and the blockchain industry is a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to manage regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation programs
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and mentor stakeholders
  • Highly self-driven, accountable, and capable of meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality.

技术环境

核心生产环境运行于 AWS / EKS，服务于 7×24 小时数字资产交易业务，对系统可用性、实时性、安全性、变更质量和故障恢复能力有较高要求。

岗位职责

  • 负责 7×24 小时核心交易业务的生产稳定性保障，覆盖交易链路、行情服务及相关基础设施；参与重大生产故障的应急响应，及时完成问题定位、风险控制、服务恢复和故障复盘，保障交易连续性和用户资产安全。
  • 负责 AWS 及 EKS/Kubernetes 生产基础设施的建设和持续优化，涵盖云架构、网络、高可用、容量规划及容灾，以及 Kubernetes 集群升级、节点生命周期、调度与资源管理、Ingress/负载均衡、DNS、存储和弹性伸缩等；持续优化云资源使用效率和成本，并从稳定性、安全性和可运维性角度参与业务技术架构设计。
  • 建设和持续完善可观测性与生产稳定性体系（Metrics、Logs、Tracing、Alerting、SLI/SLO、Incident Response、Postmortem），提升生产问题的发现、定位和恢复效率，并与研发团队共同解决系统瓶颈、单点风险及架构层面的长期稳定性问题。
  • 推动 IaC、CI/CD 和自动化运维体系建设（Terraform/Terragrunt、GitHub Actions、Ansible 等），实现基础设施和应用交付的标准化、自动化，并完善变更评审、发布、验证和回滚机制，降低生产变更风险。
  • 负责或协同完成 MySQL、Redis、Kafka 等核心数据及中间件服务的生产运维，包括高可用、监控、容量规划、备份恢复、性能优化及故障处理。
  • 推动 AWS、Kubernetes 及生产环境安全治理，包括最小权限和访问控制（IAM/RBAC）、网络隔离、容器及镜像安全、密钥与敏感信息管理（Secrets/KMS）、漏洞治理和安全审计，并协同相关团队完成安全事件响应。

任职要求

  • 计算机或相关专业统招本科及以上学历，5 年以上 DevOps、SRE、云基础设施或相关工作经验；具备中大型生产环境的一线运维、变更管理和复杂故障处理经验，兼具基础设施架构设计和实际落地能力，能够独立推进相关方案的实施和持续优化，并具备较强的风险意识和跨团队协作能力。
  • 具备扎实的 Linux、网络和容器技术基础，以及生产级 Kubernetes/EKS 实践经验，能够独立完成集群建设、升级、调优，以及 Pod、Node、网络和集群层面的复杂故障排查；了解 Java、Go 等常见应用的运行环境和基本排障方法。
  • 具备 AWS 生产环境建设和运维经验，熟悉核心云服务（IAM、VPC、EC2、EKS、ALB/NLB、Route 53、S3、CloudWatch 等），理解多可用区、高可用、网络隔离、最小权限、弹性伸缩、容量规划及成本治理等设计原则，具备生产基础设施架构设计、风险评估和故障排查能力。
  • 具备较强的 IaC、CI/CD 和自动化能力，有相关工具（Terraform/Terragrunt、GitHub Actions、Ansible 等）的实际使用经验；熟练使用脚本语言（Bash、Python 等），能够通过自动化提高基础设施和应用交付的可靠性。
  • 具备生产级可观测性和稳定性治理经验，熟悉相关技术栈（Prometheus、Grafana、ELK/Loki、OpenTelemetry 等），理解 Metrics、Logs、Tracing、SLI/SLO、告警治理、容量规划和容灾机制。
  • 熟悉 MySQL、Redis、Kafka 等常见数据及中间件服务的基本生产运维，并具备实际的安全运维或 DevSecOps 经验（AWS IAM、Kubernetes RBAC、网络安全、主机及容器安全、Secrets/KMS、漏洞治理、安全审计等），具备生产安全风险识别和处置能力。
  • 具备 Web3 / Crypto 行业生产环境运维经验，对区块链及链上业务的基本运行机制有一定理解，能够结合数字资产交易业务识别和处理相关的稳定性与安全风险。

加分项

  • 有数字资产交易所、证券、金融交易、支付等高可用实时系统生产环境经验者优先。
  • 有大规模或高流量 Kubernetes/EKS 生产环境，以及 AWS 多账号治理、跨 Region 容灾或灾备演练实践经验者优先。
  • 有较深入的云原生、云安全或成本治理实践经验者优先（如 Karpenter、Argo CD/Flux、OpenTelemetry、eBPF、FinOps 等）。

公司概述

Davion Labs 现诚邀一位具备丰富云基础设施和生产稳定性经验的高级运维 / SRE 工程师（Senior Cloud Infrastructure & SRE Engineer）加入 ApeX Protocol 核心团队。

ApeX Protocol 是领先的去中心化交易平台（DEX），核心业务 7×24 小时持续运行，对系统的稳定性、安全性、实时性及故障恢复能力有较高要求。生产基础设施以 AWS、EKS/Kubernetes（K8s） 为核心，并通过自动化、可观测性和稳定性治理持续提升系统可靠性。

在这个岗位上，您将深度参与云基础设施建设、Kubernetes 平台、IaC/CI/CD、可观测性、生产稳定性及安全治理。我们希望您既具备基础设施架构设计和系统性思考能力，也保持较强的实际落地能力，能够深入生产环境处理复杂问题，并推动问题从应急响应走向长期改进。

我们期待您具备 Web3 / Crypto 行业生产环境经验，理解链上业务的基本运行机制，并能够与研发团队紧密协作，共同建设稳定、安全、高效且具备良好扩展能力的交易基础设施。

Sapien is building Proof of Quality, an evaluation system for AI work

As AI moves from generating answers to doing real work, teams need confidence in the quality of everything their AI systems rely on and produce.

AI work includes the data going in, the reasoning in the middle, the outputs coming back, and the decisions and actions agents take. Quality matters at every step.

Proof of Quality, or PoQ, measures that work against the customer's own standard.

The customer's rubric defines quality. Agents handle the volume. Qualified experts judge what requires judgment. Consensus turns independent assessments into a measure reliable enough to act on.

Every evaluation produces a record the customer keeps. Teams can see what passed, what failed, why, and what needs to improve.

We've spent two years and 195 million tasks learning how hard it is to measure quality at scale.

Now we're hiring our first dedicated sales lead to take PoQ to market.

Why now

AI made work abundant. Judgment did not scale with it.

Models are becoming agents. Agents are moving into production. AI systems increasingly depend on complex data, perform multi-step reasoning, generate open ended work, and make decisions that affect real products and workflows.

Some quality can be checked automatically. Much of it depends on context, expertise, or judgment.

The answer cannot be to put an expert behind every piece of AI work.

Reliable judgment needs a process, and scarce expertise has to be deployed where it actually adds value.

That is the problem PoQ is built to solve.

You'll join while this market is taking shape, with direct access to the founders, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to help define how PoQ reaches it.

The role

You'll own sales end to end: prospecting, discovery, demos, pilots, pricing, negotiation, and close.

Sales today is founder led. We've opened the first doors, run the first demos, and learned where PoQ gets the strongest reaction.

Your job is to take that baseline and build from it.

There is no proven ICP to inherit.

We have strong hypotheses and early signals, but we're still mapping the buyers, use cases, segments, and price points where PoQ has the strongest pull.

That means you're selling and discovering the market at the same time.

Revenue matters. So does signal.

Every customer conversation should make us smarter about:

  • who feels the problem most acutely
  • what AI work they need confidence in
  • where quality is easy to test and where judgment becomes necessary
  • what gets them to run a pilot
  • what they will pay
  • which objections repeat
  • what they compare us to
  • where PoQ clearly wins, and where it does not

Your job is to run enough good conversations to find those patterns quickly, turn the strongest ones into pilots and revenue, and feed what you learn back into product, pricing, and positioning.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature pipeline and execute an established playbook.

If you need a locked pitch deck, settled price book, and fixed ICP before you can sell, this is probably the wrong role.

If discovering the market while selling into it sounds like the fun part, keep reading.

Credibility matters

You'll often be selling to technical buyers: AI labs, agent companies, data teams, and engineering leaders.

You should be able to run a technical demo yourself, understand the buyer's problem beyond the surface level, and handle the second and third question, not just the first.

Your outbound should sound like you understand the company you're writing to.

You should know when bringing in a founder or engineer materially improves a deal, and when you should handle it yourself.

And you should be comfortable disqualifying quickly when there isn't a real fit.

We care more about strong conversations that create real signal and business than a CRM full of polite meetings.

Who this is for

We care more about what you've actually done than where you've worked.

You don't need ten years of enterprise sales or a famous logo on your résumé.

You do need evidence that you can create opportunities and close them.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you:

  • have personally sourced and closed real business
  • are comfortable selling technical products to technical buyers
  • are excellent at discovery and getting to the real customer problem
  • use AI tools heavily in your daily work
  • think in numbers and patterns
  • work quickly and independently
  • are comfortable operating without a rigid sales playbook
  • can turn customer feedback into useful signal for product and positioning

Experience in AI, data, developer tools, infrastructure, or crypto is a strong plus.

What you'll own

Market discovery

Build a steady flow of qualified customer conversations through outbound, networks, communities, and other channels.

The goal isn't activity for its own sake. It's enough high quality market contact to learn quickly where PoQ has real pull.

Volume matters, but so does relevance. Your outreach should feel informed because it is.

Sales, end to end

Own the deal from first conversation through discovery, demo, pilot, negotiation, and signed customer.

Bring in founders and engineers when they materially improve the deal.

Pilots

Get strong prospects into useful pilots quickly.

PoQ pilots run in days rather than quarters. The rubric, panel, expected effort, and cost are defined up front, and the first Proof Report lands while the decision it informs is still open.

You'll help define success, keep pilots moving, and turn successful ones into customers, references, case studies, and expansion opportunities.

Pilots are commercial opportunities, but they are also one of the fastest ways for us to learn where PoQ creates the most value.

ICP and pricing

Treat every conversation as data.

Track use cases, objections, pricing reactions, buyer profiles, and why deals move or stall.

Use that information to sharpen our ICP, positioning, packaging, and pricing.

You'll help decide where PoQ wins, not just sell where you're told.

Network

Make intelligent use of Sapien's existing network of founders, investors, advisors, partners, and communities.

Turn warm introductions into a repeatable channel rather than an advantage spent once.

Sales operations

Own the CRM, pipeline, forecast, and the systems required to understand what's working.

Every stage should be visible. Every meaningful conversion rate should be known.

As the motion becomes repeatable, you'll help shape the sales team we build around it.

What we look for

Proof over polish.

Show us deals, pilots, partnerships, or revenue you personally helped create.

We want to understand:

  • where the opportunity started
  • what you personally owned
  • what made the deal difficult
  • what the result was
  • what the numbers looked like

We also expect:

  • daily fluency with tools like ChatGPT and Claude
  • strong research and prospecting instincts
  • enough technical aptitude to learn PoQ deeply and demo it credibly
  • comfort with modern CRM, sequencing, enrichment, and automation tools
  • a habit of measuring what works and changing what doesn't
  • speed

How you'll be measured

This role has a scoreboard, but it isn't just revenue.

Targets will be set together each quarter and evolve as we learn. They'll fall into four areas:

1. Qualified conversations. Are you consistently creating conversations with companies that have a real reason to buy?

2. Pilots. Are strong prospects moving into structured evaluations of PoQ?

3. Revenue. Are pilots and conversations turning into paying customers?

4. Market signal. Are we learning faster because of the conversations you're running? Are those insights changing who we target, what we build, how we price, or how we position PoQ?

If those numbers and signals improve quarter over quarter, you're succeeding.

Your first 90 days

By the end of your first 90 days, we expect you to have:

  • learned PoQ well enough to sell and demo it independently
  • absorbed the customer conversations and sales work already done
  • launched and iterated on your own outbound motion
  • built a meaningful pipeline of qualified opportunities
  • moved multiple strong prospects toward or into pilots
  • developed an evidence backed view of which segments, buyers, and use cases show the strongest pull
  • made meaningful commercial progress toward a repeatable sales motion

We expect speed, but we care more about learning the market correctly than manufacturing activity.

How to apply

Send us your résumé plus two or three examples of deals or pipelines you actually built.

For each, tell us:

  • the starting point
  • the result
  • the timeframe
  • what you personally owned

Screenshots of pipelines, sequences, dashboards, or other real work are welcome.

Then do one more thing:

Pick a company you think should buy Proof of Quality. Tell us why, and write the exact outbound you'd send them.

That matters more to us than a polished cover letter.

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

We are seeking a Tooling Technician to serve as a cornerstone of our fabrication and automation operations. This is a hands-on, technical role ideal for someone with deep experience in precision mechanical construction, metrology, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help establish and scale a world-class fabrication shop supporting aerospace, automotive, maritime, and defense applications.

Your Responsibilities

  • Fabricate and assemble complex tooling (e.g., jigs, fixtures, tool masters, gauges) with precision, using advanced reference systems.
  • Design and develop custom holding devices, fixtures, and tooling interfaces to improve manufacturability and efficiency.
  • Set up and utilize optical instruments and model-based metrology tools for inspection and alignment.
  • Interpret and work from detailed engineering drawings, CAD models, and specifications to perform high-precision setups.
  • Identify and recommend continuous improvements to tooling processes, documentation, and equipment utilization.

What We're Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in precision mechanical construction.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience with model-based metrology tools (e.g., laser trackers, articulated arms, or coordinate measuring machines).
  • Proficiency in geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), engineering reference systems, and complex blueprint interpretation.
  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise with bench inspection tools and advanced metrology equipment.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Knowledge of tooling integration with automated manufacturing systems.
  • Experience with building and assembling large, complex fixtures.
  • Understanding of welding processes and their impact on tooling accuracy and tolerance stack-up.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
  • 401k
  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. The Master Scheduler is responsible for the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for key programs and products, serving as the central integrator between program, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and operations timelines.

  • Track schedule performance against baseline, proactively identifying risk, quantifying impacts of changes, and surfacing key insights. Drive solutioning to achieve milestones and maintain delivery commitments.

The Role

We're hiring a Manufacturing Engineer with deep CNC machining expertise to join our team at the FX facility in Torrance, CA. You'll join a group of roughly twenty engineers and SMEs specialized across manufacturing capabilities — sheet metal, tube & pipe, and more — and bring dedicated machining depth at a moment when it matters most: our machining capacity and process maturity are directly on the critical path for one of Hadrian's highest-priority programs.

This is a process development and qualification role, not a machine operation role. You'll define machining processes from CAM strategy through first-part-off and drive them to capable, repeatable production — turning tough titanium and Inconel parts into documented, validated processes. You'll be the machining voice in capital equipment decisions, supporting SMEs through capex selection, and you'll partner with the factory development team as new capability is installed, commissioned, and brought online. It's a role for an engineer who combines hands-on machining judgment with data-driven rigor (DOE, SPC, capability studies) and wants their fingerprints on both the parts and the machines we buy — all in a fast-moving, high-mix, low-volume environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead CNC machining process development and research end to end — machining strategy, CAM/toolpath direction, cutting parameters, workholding and fixturing, and in-process probing — for complex, tight-tolerance aerospace and defense parts in a high-mix, low-volume environment (5-axis strongly preferred; mill-turn a plus), with a focus on steel, titanium and Inconel.
  • Qualify processes to capable, repeatable production: first-article builds, process capability studies (Cp/Cpk), SPC, and DOE-driven parameter optimization.
  • Serve as the CNC subject-matter expert supporting the capital equipment (capex) selection process — defining requirements and runoff criteria, evaluating machine tools, vendor assessment and capability studies, and factory acceptance testing (FAT).
  • Support the factory development team as new machining capability comes online — providing machining expertise through equipment installation, commissioning, and machine bring-up from first-part-off to fully ramped and stabilized production.
  • Provide Design for Machinability (DFM) feedback and tolerance definition to design and engineering teams, and drive cycle-time and cost-down improvements against aggressive program milestones.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in CNC machining processes in aerospace & defense, precision manufacturing, medical device, or consumer electronics environments (a BS in Mechanical/Manufacturing Engineering is great; equivalent hands-on experience is just as valued).
  • Deep multi-axis expertise: 3–5-axis simultaneous milling and turning/mill-turn, with CAM proficiency (e.g., hyperMILL, NX CAM, Mastercam) and the judgment to direct programming strategies and review toolpaths even when you're not the primary programmer.
  • Hands-on experience machining titanium, Inconel, or other difficult-to-machine alloys — practical command of cutting tools and coatings, speeds and feeds, tool-life management, and thermal/distortion control.
  • Strong fundamentals in GD&T (ASME Y14.5), workholding/fixture design, inspection, and process validation — with a demonstrated data-driven method (SPC, DOE, process capability analysis) behind yield and process-change decisions.
  • Ability to operate autonomously in a fast-moving, high-mix environment: you own workstreams end to end, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with machinists on the floor, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Capital equipment qualification experience: machine runoffs, vendor bring-up, capability studies, and factory acceptance testing — including greenfield buildouts or overseas equipment qualification.
  • Process development pedigree at scale — consumer electronics CNC (e.g., Apple MDE-style programs), space/propulsion machining, or medical device machining — with rigorous parameter and process documentation.
  • Large-format machining and/or mill-turn programming and process development experience.
  • Entrepreneurial ownership: machine-shop startup or buildout, 0-1 process launches, or products and businesses you built on your own initiative.
  • Automation and data skills: macro programming (Heidenhain/Fanuc), in-process or automated metrology, tool-life/load monitoring, or production data analysis.

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

Rain is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our onchain surface — the blockchain layer that everything else at Rain depends on. Stablecoins only work as real-world money if the onchain side is fast, safe, and invisible: collateral held in contracts, settlement across chains, custody and wallet architecture, and the asset and network coverage our partners need to operate globally. This role owns that.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the directly responsible PM for onchain end to end: smart contracts and protocol design, chain and asset integrations, settlement and treasury flows, and the infrastructure underneath it all. You'll work closely with engineering, security, compliance, legal, and directly with our fintech, neobank, and institutional partners.

What you’ll do

  • Own the roadmap for Rain's onchain product — smart contracts, chain and asset coverage, settlement, and payments — and drive it end to end

  • Partner deeply with engineering on protocol and infrastructure tradeoffs (contract architecture and upgradeability, collateralization and liquidation logic, node/RPC reliability, gas and fee strategy, bridging and cross-chain messaging) and translate them into partner-facing product decisions

  • Decide which chains, assets, and stablecoins Rain supports and when — build the framework for those calls across liquidity, security, cost, partner demand, compliance considerations, and regulatory exposure

  • Drive the security bar for onchain work — audits, monitoring, incident response, and the operational guardrails that go with holding real value onchain

  • Translate complex protocol and blockchain infrastructure into intuitive product surfaces and clear partner-facing documentation

  • Gather feedback directly from partners, distill it into sharp prioritization, and push the team toward the highest-leverage work

  • Measure ruthlessly, iterate quickly, and set a bar others want to work to

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 8-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products from zero-to-one through scale at a product-led company with a strong engineering culture and high bar for quality

  • Deep, hands-on blockchain fluency — you've shipped onchain products and can reason unaided about EVM and Solana mechanics (and other chains), smart contract design and upgrade patterns, gas economics, bridging models, and other onchain tradeoffs

  • Exceptional product judgment and analytical rigor — you're someone others describe as one of the sharpest PMs they've worked with, and you consistently raise the bar for the people around you

  • A senior, autonomous operator who can define the problem, drive the plan, and own the outcome without needing close direction

  • Sound instincts on onchain security and risk: you know where value gets lost, you push for audits and monitoring before incidents rather than after, and you can weigh a shipping deadline against a real risk without flinching

  • Strong technical fluency beyond the chain itself (APIs, distributed systems, payments and ledger design) and the instinct to pull on technical threads yourself rather than defer to engineering

  • Genuinely excited to live in the details — you believe product quality is won in the specifics and are energized by the work to get them right

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can operate with sophisticated external partners and internal engineering teams with equal ease

  • Proven ability to ship quickly, measure adoption, and iterate in a fast-moving environment

Bonus attributes:

  • Experience with stablecoin issuance, onchain lending or collateralized credit, or tokenized asset products

  • Background at a protocol, L1/L2, wallet, custodian, or onchain infrastructure company

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, Tron, Bitcoin L2s) and multi-chain operations at scale

  • Experience with payments, card issuing, or cross-border fintech products

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape around digital assets and custody

  • Previous startup or hypergrowth environment experience

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s B2B organization serves a diverse range of institutional and professional clients, supported by a growing ecosystem of sales tools and customer relationship management platforms. As our business continues to scale, we are seeking an experienced CRM Product Manager to define and drive the product strategy for the tools and workflows that enable our sales teams.

This role will own the CRM roadmap and prioritization across multiple B2B sales teams, partnering closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable product solutions. You will help establish a clear vision for how Salesforce and other sales technologies support Kraken’s go-to-market organization while creating greater consistency across platforms, processes, and data.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with practical Salesforce fluency. You are comfortable navigating competing stakeholder priorities, turning ambiguous requests into well-defined product requirements, and making thoughtful trade-offs across multiple teams and platforms. You understand how sales organizations operate and can distinguish between product, process, data, and technology challenges.

This is first and foremost a product and strategy role. You will have enough hands-on knowledge of CRM platforms to scope solutions, challenge assumptions, and occasionally unblock straightforward configuration needs, while partnering with administrators and engineers for implementation.

 

The opportunity

  • Own and evolve the CRM and sales tooling product strategy and roadmap across Kraken’s B2B sales organization, defining how Salesforce and other sales platforms should support different sales motions and customer segments

  • Lead prioritization across competing stakeholder needs, making clear, data-informed trade-offs and sequencing work against available delivery capacity

  • Serve as the first product-level point of assessment for incoming CRM needs, evaluating urgency, identifying underlying product, process, integration, or data issues, and translating requests into clearly scoped work

  • Establish and continuously improve scalable intake and prioritization processes that provide teams with a consistent path for requesting CRM enhancements and support

  • Drive product coherence across multiple CRM and sales platforms, defining clear ownership of records, workflows, integrations, and data across systems

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

The Factory Construction Manager is the field-based owner of construction execution — the person on the ground making sure our factories get built on schedule, on budget, and to the quality standard our manufacturing operations demand. This role sits at the center of factory development, translating the project plan into daily forward progress and holding the field accountable to it. As we scale our manufacturing footprint, the pace and complexity of construction only increases; this role is what keeps that momentum from slipping. It requires someone who thrives in a dynamic, high-consequence environment, who runs toward problems rather than around them, and who treats the schedule as a commitment rather than a suggestion.

You will serve as the day-to-day owner's representative on active construction sites, working with project teams to drive progress against the schedule and customer milestones while holding general contractors and subcontractors accountable to safety, quality, and sequencing. You'll lead weekly coordination meetings to keep contractors aligned to the plan, track production and quantities in the field to catch schedule and budget drift early and mitigate any potential delays. You will write daily reports that give the broader project team clear visibility into progress and critical issues. Working cross-functionally with the project team, you'll support project planning sessions, validate contractor invoicing, and champion a strong safety and quality culture across every phase of the build. Ultimately, you own what gets built in the field — and you make sure it matches what the project promised.

What You’ll Do

  • Schedule Performance Oversight: Drive construction progress in the field in accordance with the project schedule and customer set milestones. Review the project schedule weekly to determine if any activities are behind schedule and address with contractors in weekly coordination meeting.
  • Daily Construction Coordination: Support daily coordination with construction contractors in the field to ensure that work remains on track.
  • Daily Construction Reporting: Write daily reports sighting construction progress and critical issues.
  • Site Safety Ownership: Ensure proper safety programs and culture are being implemented in the field.
  • Site Quality Ownership: Ensure that construction contractors are upholding quality standards throughout the lifecycle of the project
  • Construction Project Planning: Support the project team in project planning sessions to stay ahead of work out in the field. Work with the contractors to develop necessary construction execution plans to drive work.
  • Weekly Contractor Planning: Conduct weekly construction coordination meetings with subcontractors to establish a plan of action in accordance with the schedule.
  • Weekly Production Tracking: Work with the project team to track quantities and measure progress out in the field. Work with the project team to analyze production rates in the field to compare to the schedule and budget.
  • Invoice Approval Support: Work with project team to validate contractor invoicing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 15 years of construction management experience in capital project execution, manufacturing facilities, and/or industrial applications
  • Direct field ownership of projects with GC or subcontractor oversight
  • Proficiency in Procore, Bluebeam, and scheduling software (P6, MS Project, or Smartsheets)
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

What Will Set You Apart

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management
  • An understanding of earned value metrics
  • Strong scheduling skills
  • CCM certification
  • OSHA 30-hour certification
  • FMEA risk assessment knowledge
  • Site surveying skills

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for key programs and products, serving as the central integrator between program, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and operations timelines.

This position partners cross-functionally to ensure alignment between engineering schedules, supply chain lead times, and delivery commitments in a dynamic, high-mix NPI manufacturing environment.

What You'll Do

  • Own the IMS. Develop Integrated Master Schedules for products, programs, capabilities, and production sites. Sequence development, procurement, construction, equipment installation, and qualification activities across concurrent NPI and factory-buildout workstreams for feasible schedules.
  • Own updates and ensure the schedule is a trusted tool for decision-making and reliable source of valid data.
  • Track schedule performance against baseline, proactively identifying risk, quantifying impacts of changes, and surfacing key insights. Drive solutioning to achieve milestones and maintain delivery commitments.
  • Facilitate cross-functional schedule reviews and ensure stakeholder alignment on milestone dates, deliverables, and resource trade-offs. Drive accountability for on-time delivery.
  • Support definition of scheduling philosophy, standards, and patterns. Systematize and automate to efficiently scale scheduling.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in integrated scheduling, project management, or engineering or manufacturing planning.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing an Integrated Master Schedule.
  • Strong knowledge of scheduling methodologies and principles, including for estimating durations and qualifying risk.
  • Experience using scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheets, etc) and building automations and connectors.
  • Ability to partner with stakeholders and drive accountability. Strong communicator and relationship builder.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience in development and scaling phases of aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other complex hardware manufacturing industries.
  • Undeterred by ambiguity and proven delivery of meaningful outcomes.
  • Ability to bring structure and process to fast-paced environments while maintaining velocity
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-program production environments and/or working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar analytics tools.
