Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

At Hadrian, data is part of the factory's operating system. The scheduler deciding what runs next, models predicting cycle time and demand, systems interpreting engineering drawings, analytics tracking production, and operators understanding what is happening on the floor all depend on the same thing: a trustworthy path from the physical and software systems that generate data to the teams and products that use it.

The Data Platform team owns that path. We build the shared infrastructure for ingestion and CDC, event streaming, the warehouse and lakehouse, orchestration, data contracts, quality, lineage, and the foundational data models that sit underneath Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and operational software. Today that includes Snowflake, Iceberg on S3, PeerDB, Redpanda/Kafka, Dagster, dbt, Kubernetes, and protobuf/gRPC. Some of our data begins in conventional software systems. Some begins on CNC machines, inspection equipment, PLCs, engineering files, and the factory floor.

As an Senior Engineering Manager, you will build and lead the team responsible for making this platform reliable, coherent, and useful as Hadrian scales to many factories. You will own the people, execution, operating quality, and direction of the team while staying technically close enough to challenge architecture, understand failure modes, and help engineers make good tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the team and platform that become Hadrian's data backbone. Lead the engineers responsible for the path from machines and operational systems to the trusted datasets, streams, and interfaces that scheduling, analytics, ML, software, and factory operations depend on.
  • Own the Data Platform roadmap and delivery. Turn ambiguous needs across Software, Infrastructure, Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and Manufacturing into clear priorities, interfaces, owners, and commitments.
  • Raise the operational bar for the platform: reliability, data-quality SLAs, observability, incident response, backfills and recovery, cost, security, schema evolution, provenance, and clear ownership when something fails.
  • Partner with senior engineers and technical leads on architecture across CDC and streaming, Snowflake and Iceberg, orchestration, data contracts, schema governance, and the interfaces between the data platform and its consumers. You do not need to design every system yourself, but you need the depth to ask the hard questions and recognize when important semantics or failure modes are missing.
  • Turn repeated one-off work into paved roads. Build standards, contracts, tooling, documentation, and migration paths that let other engineering and data teams move faster without creating a collection of bespoke pipelines.
  • Hire and grow an exceptional team. Set a clear technical and performance bar, give direct feedback, develop engineers into broader technical leaders, delegate real ownership, and build a team whose capability grows faster than its headcount.

What We’re Looking For

  • A track record leading engineers responsible for production data infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, infrastructure, or similarly critical technical systems. For Senior EM, you have led multiple substantial workstreams or teams and developed senior technical leaders.
  • Strong technical judgment in modern data and platform systems: event streaming and CDC, warehouses and lakehouses, orchestration, schema evolution, data modeling, distributed-system failure modes, and the tradeoffs behind reliable data delivery.
  • Experience building for environments with real constraints. You understand that the architecture changes when data comes from hardware, machines, devices, files, telemetry, regulated systems, edge environments, or other sources that do not behave like a clean application database.
  • A real platform mindset. You think in shared abstractions, contracts, ownership, operating guarantees, adoption, migration, deprecation, and paved roads — not just a set of infrastructure components owned by one team.
  • An operator's mindset. You know what your systems promise, how you know they are healthy, what happens when those promises fail, and how an incident becomes a permanent improvement rather than a recurring story.
  • Strong people leadership and high agency across organizational boundaries. Your engineers know what is expected of them, where they stand, and how they can grow; when a dependency is blocking the team, you go resolve it rather than simply reporting it upward.

What Will Set You Apart

  • 5+ years of management experience in manufacturing, semiconductors, hardware, robotics, autonomy, industrial systems, test/measurement, or edge computing, especially where the data platform had to bridge software with physical systems. Backgrounds from companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Xilinx, Altera, Qualcomm, Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tesla, Anduril, Shield AI, or similar environments are especially relevant.
  • Experience with heterogeneous data beyond application tables: telemetry, events, files, device identity, timestamps and clock drift, units, provenance, schema drift, deletes, late or out-of-order data, partial records, retries, and backfills.
  • Experience taking a data or infrastructure platform from an early working system to a broadly adopted internal product used by many teams.
  • Experience operating in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as aerospace, defense, FedRAMP, CMMC, or other environments where data governance and access control are part of the architecture.
  • A track record of building strong hiring and onboarding systems and helping senior engineers become effective technical leads, Staff+ engineers, or future managers.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $249,000 - $299,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
  • 401k
  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

1Money is hiring its second information security team member. This is a rare opportunity to join a lean, fast-moving fintech at the ground floor and co-own a broad security portfolio from day one. You will work directly alongside our CISO, covering a wide range of objectives across cloud security, application security, detection and response, identity, and compliance engineering. Over time, you will have the freedom and support to develop a primary specialty in the area that energizes you most. If you want to build something real, work on hard problems, and leave your fingerprints on a security program that actually matters, this role is for you.
Job Responsibilities
  • Application & Product Security:
    • Partner with engineering to embed security into the SDLC.
    • Conduct threat modeling, design reviews, and code-level security assessments.
    • Manage vulnerability disclosure, dependency scanning, and CI/CD tooling.

    • Harden and monitor AWS environments.
    • Manage and tune cloud security posture tools and respond to findings.
    • Support architectural reviews for new services and infrastructure changes.
  • Detection, Response & SIEM:
    • Build and tune detection rules across SIEM, EDR, cloud, and app logs.
    • Lead incident investigations, triage alerts, and drive response activities.
    • Develop playbooks and runbooks to reduce response times.
  • Identity & Endpoint:
    • Administer and evolve identity infrastructure including SSO, MFA, and FIDO2/passkey controls.
    • Support MDM policies and endpoint security controls for a distributed Mac fleet.
    • Drive network security initiatives for a fully remote workforce.
  • Compliance Engineering:
    • Translate compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001) into actionable technical controls.
    • Integrate evidence collection and control validation into engineering workflows.
    • Partner with the CISO on audit preparation and regulatory engagements.
Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in hands-on security engineering.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Commercial Legal team is at the forefront of Kraken’s global business operations, serving as strategic legal partners across all departments. This lean and dynamic group is responsible for managing a wide range of commercial contracts and supporting the company in its partnerships, procurement, licensing, and vendor relationships. The team plays a key role in enabling Kraken’s rapid innovation and expansion while protecting the business from legal and regulatory risks.

As Assistant General Counsel – Commercial (Partnerships), you will report directly to the Head of Commercial Legal. The opportunity

  • Excellent contract drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring and managing high-performing teams.

  • Ability to operate independently and decisively in a fast-paced, remote-first, innovation-driven environment.

 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with vendor onboarding, procurement processes, and compliance frameworks.

  • Background working closely with product and engineering teams to develop and launch consumer-facing and enterprise products.

  • Experience implementing or managing contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools.

  • Passion for crypto, Web3, and emerging technologies.

About the Company



We believe financial services should be more accessible, that’s why we started Axis. A fully interoperable mobile wallet which enables users to send and receive money from any mobile wallet in Egypt, pay their bills, buy anything online with a virtual Visa card, or scan any QR code to pay for anything in-person. Axis empowers small businesses with simplified digital payments to compete & grow. Our digital banking platform enables small businesses to seamlessly manage payments to employees and suppliers. Small businesses can now send salaries, reimbursements and instantly pay their suppliers on any mobile wallet in Egypt.



About the Role



The Senior Backend Software Engineer will build and maintain scalable, secure backend systems for Axis' fintech platform, focusing on microservices, APIs, and distributed architecture. The role requires 5+ years of backend development experience, strong programming skills, and expertise in designing high-performance, reliable systems.



Responsibilities



  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, highly available, and secure backend services for our fintech applications.
  • Own the technical design and implementation of microservices, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to establish clear bounded contexts, domain boundaries, and service responsibilities.
  • Design and evolve event-driven architectures, including asynchronous communication, event processing, reliability, and failure-handling strategies.
  • Design and implement reliable business workflows using Temporal or similar workflow orchestration technologies, including long-running processes, retries, compensation, and failure recovery.
  • Make sound architectural and technical decisions across services, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and delivery requirements.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex issues across a distributed services ecosystem, including production incidents, performance bottlenecks, data consistency issues, and service failures.
  • Design robust RESTful APIs and service-to-service communication patterns with appropriate versioning, security, error handling, and backward compatibility.
  • Drive improvements in system performance, scalability, resilience, and reliability through profiling, benchmarking, architectural improvements, and optimization.
  • Establish and improve observability across backend systems using logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Ensure engineering solutions follow high standards for security, code quality, testing, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Conduct and contribute to architecture and code reviews, providing technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Research, evaluate, and benchmark technologies and architectural approaches against industry best practices and best-in-class solutions.
  • Identify technical risks and proactively drive improvements to architecture, engineering practices, and system reliability.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and long-term technical strategy.



Qualifications



  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building backend and distributed systems.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Strong hands-on experience with backend frameworks such as Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, or NestJS.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD), including bounded contexts, aggregates, domain services, and service boundaries.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing systems.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration, preferably Temporal or a comparable workflow engine.
  • Strong experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including data modeling and performance considerations.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, API versioning, security, error handling, and backward compatibility.
  • Hands-on experience with performance tuning, profiling, debugging, and troubleshooting distributed applications.
  • Strong understanding of observability, including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Strong experience writing and maintaining unit, integration, and automated tests.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, scalability, resilience, fault tolerance, and maintainability.
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts such as idempotency, eventual consistency, retries, circuit breakers, distributed transactions, and failure recovery.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical problems and identify systemic solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.



Preferred Skills



  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other high-volume/high-availability environments.
  • Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging and streaming platforms.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience designing systems for high throughput, low latency, and high availability.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical direction across a team or organization.
  • Experience working with both cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.

As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency.

At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you.

Why Offchain?
Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.

Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.

Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.

To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

The Role:
Offchain seeks a Head of Enterprise to own the commercial strategy and collaboration with Product for the company’s blockchain services platform. The ideal GM is a leader who can seamlessly navigate technical complexity, commercial strategy, and team management while maintaining deep customer focus and driving measurable business outcomes in the rapidly evolving blockchain ecosystem.

What You’ll Do:

  • Commercial Strategy Responsibilities: Develop the commercial strategy (e.g. potential revenue streams, growth and go-to-market strategies) and success metrics for our platform offering. Forge partnerships within the Arbitrum and broader Ethereum ecosystem to drive impact across our products. Represent the product(s) externally as a thought leader – evangelizing our offering at industry events, and with key partners or early adopters, to drive adoption and trust
  • Customer Focus & Product Excellence: Maintain a razor sharp focus on delivering value to teams building onchain applications. Work directly with our users and customers to shape industry-leading products, and serve as a key stakeholder in the sales and business development process. Ensure that everything we ship as part of our platform offering is class-leading with no compromises on security, performance, or ease-of-use
  • Product Collaboration: You will work closely with product teams to ensure the needs and feature requests of both existing and prospective customers are incorporated throughout the platform’s development. You will also provide product teams with deal-driven insights and timelines, helping prioritize features based on customer importance and active negotiations
  • Cross-Functional Management: Build and lead a high-performing organization including product and design teams; coordinating closely with engineering leads. As a business unit leader, coordinate cross-functionally with Legal/Compliance (to navigate evolving crypto regulations), Security, Marketing, and Partnerships. Manage the Platform team’s KPIs and budgets, and communicate progress to Offchain's leadership




Who You Are:

  • Strategic and Commercial Acumen: Visionary mindset to shape product strategy aligned with company goals, paired with data-driven decision-making. Understands product metrics, growth funnels, and can define OKRs. Business savvy to identify market opportunities. Experience defining go-to-market strategies and driving user growth/engagement metrics is important
  • Enterprise Commercial & Deal Leadership: Proven ability to acquire, negotiate, and close complex enterprise and commercial deals, owning the full customer lifecycle from initial engagement through contract execution, onboarding, and long-term expansion. Experienced in managing strategic accounts, growing revenue through renewals, upsell, and cross-sell, and building trusted executive relationships to expand platform adoption over time
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of digital wallets, payments, or Web3 products. Experience in consumer fintech (digital banking, payment apps, etc.) or crypto is required – mixed Web2/Web3 experience is a plus. Familiarity with blockchain tech, Ethereum ecosystem, and self-custody wallets is highly desirable, or a strong ability to learn these quickly
  • Leadership & Execution Skills: Strong people leader able to recruit and build a diverse team. Excellent project management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Has led cross-functional teams and can coordinate between technical, creative, and business stakeholders. Exceptional communication skills to articulate vision and strategy to both internal teams and external partners/users




What You’ll Need:

  • 12+ years of experience in commercial leadership, enterprise sales business development, product strategy, or general management roles
  • Proven Experience owning and scaling enterprise/ commercial revenue streams and go-to-market strategies
  • Track record of acquiring, negotiating, and closing complex enterprise and commercial deals
  • Experience managing strategic accounts, renewals, expansions, upsell, and cross-sell motions
  • Experience leading cross functional teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal/ Compliance, and Partnerships
  • Strong Background in fintech, payments, digital wallets crypto or blockchain platforms (mixed web2/ web3 experience is preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex, fast-moving product environments
  • Experience building leading and scaling high-performing teams
  • Strong commercial, analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management experience

Global Services is the centre of expertise at Chainalysis — the team that translates our platform, data, and investigative capabilities into real-world impact for customers across law enforcement, national security, financial institutions, and the broader crypto ecosystem.


Chainalysis is seeking a Deployment Strategist to join Global Services as a core technical practitioner. This is not a traditional services or solutions engineering role. Deployment Strategists are embedded technical experts who own the full lifecycle of customer value — from problem discovery and investigation through solution design, deployment, and customer enablement.

The role sits at the intersection of blockchain investigation, data analytics, domain expertise, and customer partnership. You will work directly with customers to understand their mission, conduct investigations, build tailored solutions, and enable customer teams to operationalise Chainalysis independently. Success requires deep investigative capability, genuine domain expertise, technical skill, and the ability to build trusted relationships through credibility — not just communication.

This is the role that makes Chainalysis essential to how our customers operate.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own end-to-end customer engagements — from discovery through investigation, solution design, deployment, enablement, and ongoing value delivery

  • Conduct blockchain investigations across the Chainalysis platform, applying tracing, OSINT, and analytical techniques to real customer problems

  • Partner directly with customers to understand investigative, intelligence, compliance, or operational objectives and translate them into actionable outcomes

  • Design, build, and maintain custom workflows, notebooks, dashboards, queries, and data models using Chainalysis data and products

  • Enable customers to operate solutions independently — building their capability so that Chainalysis becomes embedded in their operational infrastructure

  • Act as the primary technical and domain advisor for your customers, building trusted relationships through hands-on expertise and credibility

  • Deliver live training, demos, investigative walkthroughs, and technical briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Support pre-sales technical engagement for complex and strategic deals — helping customers understand what's possible and how to get there

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales to influence roadmap and improve offerings based on field intelligence

  • Develop and share domain expertise, investigative techniques, and best practices that raise the capability of the wider GS team

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Conducted or directly supported cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain intelligence work, or financial crime analysis in an operational environment

  • Deep familiarity with blockchain ecosystems (BTC, ETH, stablecoins, DeFi) and how on-chain data is used in investigations, compliance, or intelligence workflows

  • Delivered customer-facing technical solutions — whether investigative outputs, data products, or analytical workflows — in complex, real-world environments

  • Worked directly with customers in law enforcement, national security, intelligence, compliance, financial crime, or security-focused domains

  • Built insights from large or complex datasets and communicated findings to varied audiences — from analysts to executives

  • Operated successfully in fast-paced, ambiguous environments requiring ownership, adaptability, and sound judgment

  • Excellent English and Hindi

Required Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, transformation, and solution development

  • Experience building notebooks, dashboards, and analytical workflows

  • Solid understanding of data modelling, querying, and working with large datasets

  • Ability to quickly develop deep expertise in Chainalysis data structures, schemas, and products

Domain Expertise

  • Substantive knowledge of at least one domain: financial and cyber crime investigations, sanctions and compliance, fraud, national security, DeFi/protocol security, tax, or private sector risk

  • Understanding of how customers in your domain operate — their workflows, regulatory environment, and what success looks like for them

  • Ability to apply domain knowledge to shape investigation approach, solution design, and customer advisory

Nice to have experience:

  • Direct experience with Chainalysis products

  • Background in law enforcement, intelligence, or military investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, Travel Rule)

  • Experience with data engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, cloud-based analytics)

  • Published research, intelligence products, or thought leadership in blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Marcus Tay (郑旭凯）

Marcus Tay (郑旭凯）

Talent Acquisition Partner | HRBP | BIT

About BIT:


BIT (formerly Matrixport) is a global digital asset financial services and infrastructure group. Headquartered in Singapore and founded in 2019, BIT bridges traditional finance and digital assets through governance-driven financial services and technology.

The firm manages over US$7 billion in assets and facilitates more than US$7 billion in monthly trading volume. BIT offers services including custody, trading, asset and wealth management, liquidity and financing solutions, and tokenised real-world assets (RWA), serving institutional and professional investors globally.

BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan.


For more information, visit www.bit.com


Why Join Us:


At BIT, we tackle complex problems as a team. We encourage openness and promote transparency, respect, and inclusivity. Every team member is valued and has a voice that can be heard. We are always in search of intellectually curious and entrepreneurial individuals who are keen on making an impact in the crypto ecosystem and in building a better product for the next one billion users.


About the role:


As part of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Monitoring & Investigations Team, you will be responsible for conducting Transaction Monitoring for our key clients. The Transaction Monitoring Specialist plays a critical role in detecting, investigating, and reporting potentially suspicious activities across fiat and virtual asset products, ensuring compliance with AML/CFT and sanctions requirements in a fast‑growing digital assets environment. Additionally, you will actively contribute to the ongoing enhancement of our compliance controls, ensuring BIT adheres to both internal and industry standards for AML. We are looking for a candidate based in Malaysia.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and investigate alerts generated from transaction monitoring systems covering both fiat and crypto (on‑chain and off‑chain) flows, including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and trades.
  • Perform end‑to‑end case investigations: gather data, review KYC/customer profiles, analyze counterparties and wallets, document rationale, and recommend case closure or escalation.
  • Conduct blockchain analysis using analytics tools (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic, CipherTrace) to trace fund flows, identify risk patterns, and assess exposure to designated risk categories.
  • Identify unusual patterns, typologies, and emerging risks specific to crypto and propose enhancements to monitoring rules and scenarios.
  • Prepare high‑quality Suspicious Transaction/Activity Reports (STRs/SARs) with clear and concise narratives, supporting evidence, and defensible conclusions for submission to the MLRO and relevant authorities.
  • Support and ensure travel rule requirements are met by reviewing alerts generated by service provider (e,g. Notabene, Sumsub, etc)
  • Support periodic tuning, calibration, and validation of transaction monitoring rules, thresholds, and models to balance effectiveness and alert quality in line with the business risk appetite.
  • Contribute to internal training by sharing typologies, red flags, and lessons learned from cases, and help drive continuous improvement in monitoring quality and efficiency.
  • Stay abreast of regulatory developments, enforcement actions, and financial crime trends relating to virtual assets, stablecoins, DeFi, and cross‑border payments.


Job Requirements:


  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in AML transaction monitoring, investigations, or financial crime compliance within banks, fintechs, payment institutions, or crypto platforms.
  • Degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.
  • Good understanding of AML/CFT and sanctions frameworks applicable to virtual assets and payment services (e.g. MAS, PSA, FATF VASP guidance, US/EU standards is a plus).
  • Familiarity with common crypto financial crime typologies
  • Hands‑on experience with transaction monitoring systems and case management tools; ability to work with large datasets and multiple data sources to form a coherent view of customer activity.
  • Strong analytical and critical‑thinking skills; able to identify patterns, connect disparate data points, and make risk‑based decisions under time pressure.
  • Strong risk‑based judgment, with the ability to balance regulatory expectations, business needs, and customer experience.
  • Proven track record executing end‑to‑end investigations from alert review through escalation/closure and STR/SAR drafting.
  • High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline to ensure audit‑ready case files and reproducible decisioning.
  • Professional certifications in AML/Compliance (e.g. ACAMS, ICA) and/or crypto compliance are an advantage.
  • Fluency in both English and Chinese, with the ability to handle documents and databases in Chinese and liaise with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.

BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan.


For more information, visit www.bit.com


Why Join Us:

At BIT, we tackle complex problems as a team. We encourage openness and promote transparency, respect, and inclusivity. Every team member is valued and has a voice that can be heard. We are always in search of intellectually curious and entrepreneurial individuals who are keen on making an impact in the crypto ecosystem and in building a better product for the next one billion users.


Key Responsibilities


1. Regulatory Leadership & Governance

  • Act as primary contact for the SFC, external counsel, auditors and key industry stakeholders, and lead the Type 1 / Type 4 licence application through to grant.
  • Establish, refine and enforce internal control systems, operational workflows and risk management policies aligned with SFC codes and guidelines, including the VA dealing and advisory licensing conditions and Terms & Conditions.
  • Supervise post-licensure daily operations, ensuring adherence to the SFO, the Code of Conduct, FRR and AML/CFT requirements.


2. Product & Business Strategy

  • Work with product and business leads to convert client needs and market opportunities into commercially sound, regulatory-compliant strategies for professional investors.
  • Evaluate, negotiate and integrate external vendors and SFC-licensed platform partners, including digital payment on/off-ramp solutions, to ensure compliant fund flows.
  • Track market, competitor and regulatory developments to guide the product roadmap and support licence applications, including the forthcoming AMLO VA dealing and advisory regimes.


3. Culture & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Bridge technical, product and compliance teams so that regulatory requirements are embedded in product design from day one.
  • Adaptive, innovative culture able to respond quickly to shifting market and regulatory conditions.


Job Requirements

  • SFC-approved Responsible Officer for both Type 1 and Type 4 — currently, or within the past three years. (***Licence must be free from the "non-sole" condition and from any other condition restricting supervision of these activities.)
  • Hong Kong based and available at all times to supervise the regulated activities.
  • Minimum 10 years in securities dealing and/or advisory, including at least 5 years in a supervisory capacity. Must have at least 3 years' relevant industry experience within the past 6 years, plus 2 years' management experience.
  • Proven record of building compliance frameworks, managing SFC licence applications end to end, and overseeing daily regulated operations.
  • Working command of the SFC/ HKMA Joint Circular (Dec 2023) and Supplemental Joint Circular (Sep 2025) — omnibus and introducing-agent models with SFC-licensed platforms, professional-investor scoping, the VA knowledge test, token due diligence, custody and segregation, and VA-specific AML/CFT including the Travel Rule and on-chain source of funds.
  • Degree in accounting, business administration, economics, finance or law (or CFA/ CIIA/ CFP); HKSI LE Papers 1, 2, 7 & 8 or approved exemption; CPT in good standing.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to articulate compliance requirements clearly to technical and product teams.
  • Fluency in English and Chinese (Both Cantonese and Mandarin).
  • Clean regulatory, disciplinary, criminal and bankruptcy record. Full disclosure of outside directorships and group-entity roles required at application.

About the Role:


We are building a U.S. retail stock brokerage from 0 to 1 — both the client-facing app and a self-built trading system. On the app side, the core product architecture is already in place; you will drive product design for modules including market data, investment decision-support, and AI features. On the back-end system side, you will own the 0-to-1 system build-out and product planning at the module level.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Help users understand the market efficiently and comprehensively: markets page and rankings (movers / turnover / unusual activity), earnings and economic calendars, macro data, etc.
  • Help users dig deep into individual stocks: enriched stock-detail-page data and the company fundamentals (F10) module
  • Help users discover trading opportunities: stock screener, sector and thematic filters, smart watchlist alerts, etc.
  • Reinvent these experiences with AI: AI earnings summaries, price-move attribution, natural-language stock screening — turning professional-grade data into a product everyday investors can actually use
  • External counterparty integrations: connect multiple upstream executing brokers, clearing firms, corporate-action service providers, etc.
  • Trading-chain product design: order management (OMS), order routing, execution reports, and the full order-lifecycle state machine
  • Account and funds rule design: cash / margin buying power, deposit and withdrawal flows, funds clearing and settlement
  • Back-office module product design: end-of-day settlement, reconciliation, accounting / ledger system, corporate-action processing
  • Partner with finance and business teams to improve the efficiency of account and funds management, and drive the necessary product iterations
  • Own event tracking and funnel metrics to provide data input for prioritization decisions
  • Competitive benchmarking: in-depth research across competitor products; produce regular gap analyses to support product decisions


Job Requirements:


  • 4+ years of fintech product experience, including 2+ years on U.S. equities brokerage products.
  • Deep expertise in either of the following directions is required: client-facing (market data / markets & discovery / stock-level content) or trading back-end (trading / accounts / clearing & settlement) — plus a working knowledge of the other, and the willingness and ability to ramp up on it quickly.
  • Deep understanding of U.S. equities trading, settlement, and clearing; solid grasp of U.S. market data, the three financial statements and valuation metrics, and how corporate actions affect accounts and positions
  • Strong PRD craft: field-level definitions, calculation formulas, state machines, and complete edge-case coverage; fluent written and spoken English
  • Way of working: responsive, self-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to deliver high quality within an established framework


Preferred:


  • Built market-data, fundamentals, or market-discovery modules at a leading online brokerage or financial data platform
  • Brokerage back-end system experience; hands-on 0-to-1 experience at the module level
  • Deep daily use of AI tools in your workflow

For more information, visit www.bit.com


Role Summary

You will join the structured products team, working across crypto and US equities to design, price, and commercialize structured products. Sitting at the intersection of trading, sales, and product, you will turn market views and client needs into tradable payoffs (yield enhancement, principal protection, leverage, and volatility products) and drive distribution to institutional and high-net-worth clients. This is a dual-track role: you own both the quantitative structuring and the client-facing business development.


Job Responsibilities

Product Structuring

  • Design and price structured products referencing crypto assets and US equities / indices
  • Build and maintain pricing models; run scenario and Greeks analysis
  • Draft term sheets and payoff descriptions
  • Coordinate hedging with the trading desk to ensure products are executable and hedgeable

Business Development & Client Coverage

  • Originate and grow relationships with institutional clients, asset managers, family offices, and HNW investors
  • Understand client risk appetite and structure bespoke solutions
  • Own the full sales cycle — pitch, negotiate, close, and manage post-trade relationships and reissuance
  • Provide market color and product ideas; collect feedback to shape the product roadmap

Pricing, Risk & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Run valuation, sensitivity analysis, and scenario tests using internal models
  • Monitor exposure and market events over the life of each product
  • Work with Legal, Risk, and Operations to ensure smooth, compliant trade flow


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's or above in Finance, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • 3+ years in structured products, exotic derivatives, or equity / crypto derivatives structuring, sales, or trading (bank, broker-dealer, or crypto platform)
  • Strong grasp of options pricing and payoff mechanics (Black-Scholes, volatility surface, autocall / barrier features)
  • Proficient in Python / Excel for pricing and analysis
  • Understanding of the crypto derivatives market (perps, options, funding, on-chain yield) or US equity derivatives
  • An existing network of institutional / HNW clients is a strong plus
  • Excellent communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese

Personal Qualities

  • Market-driven mindset; able to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Detail-oriented, responsible, with strong independent thinking
  • Strong interest in structured products and client business

Why Join Us

  • Build products from concept to execution with genuine ownership.
  • Work alongside experienced traders, quants, and institutional sales professionals.
  • Gain exposure to global institutional investors and sophisticated derivatives markets.
  • Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial platform with significant career progression opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

THE ROLE

As a Backend Engineer focused on Solana, you will help build secure DeFi products across on-chain programs and the backend systems that support them. You will work on protocol integrations, transaction infrastructure, product APIs, and production operations. This is a hands-on role combining smart contract engineering, backend development, and applied security for systems that manage real assets.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain Solana programs and backend services that power Veda’s DeFi products.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

  • Integrate third-party DeFi protocols and infrastructure, evaluating technical and economic risks and maintaining those integrations as external systems evolve.

  • Build reliable APIs, data pipelines, SDKs, and internal tools that connect on-chain functionality with user-facing products and operational workflows.

  • Design for security and financial correctness, including clear trust boundaries, safe state transitions, access control, precision, reconciliation, and recovery from partial failures.

  • Improve the scalability, reliability, performance, and developer experience of our Solana platform.

  • Develop comprehensive automated tests, participate in security reviews and audits, and drive findings through remediation and production verification.

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, research, and external partners while documenting important technical decisions and operational procedures.

YOU HAVE

  • Strong professional experience with Rust and the ability to reason about security-critical systems code.

  • Deep knowledge of Solana and the SVM, including its account model, transaction lifecycle, token standards, performance constraints, and common security considerations.

  • Experience building Solana programs and the backend services or SDKs that configure, invoke, index, or operate them.

  • Experience designing and operating production APIs and distributed services in a language such as Python or TypeScript.

  • Strong DeFi fundamentals, including vaults, lending, trading, liquidity, fees, pricing, and cross-chain systems.

  • A security mindset and experience building systems that handle real money, with careful attention to correctness, auditability, and incident response.

  • Strong testing practices across unit, integration, and end-to-end environments, including working with real external dependencies.

  • High agency and clear communication. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a reviewed design, incremental implementation, production rollout, and durable handoff.

  • Production experience with Anchor, native Solana development, and the Solana token ecosystem.

  • Experience integrating with major Solana DeFi protocols or building vault, lending, trading, staking, or bridge products.

  • Knowledge of EVM smart contracts or cross-chain systems.

  • Experience with secure key management, multisig or custody workflows, and institutional blockchain infrastructure.

  • Experience with cloud-native services, event-driven systems, containers, deployment pipelines, and production observability.

  • Contributions to open-source blockchain infrastructure or comfort using modern agentic development tools without weakening engineering judgment.

WHAT YOU’LL WALK INTO

We’re a 35-person team that has raised $18M at Series A. Veda’s infrastructure is already running in production and supporting billions in TVL, and Solana is an important area of continued investment. You’ll help expand our capabilities, strengthen reliability and security, and make the platform easier for the team to extend as the business grows. The work is highly collaborative, ownership-focused, and close to both product and protocol design.

COMPENSATION

Competitive base salary plus equity. We’re a Series A company heading toward Series B, early enough that your equity is meaningful, late enough that the business is real.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Veda builds vault infrastructure for DeFi at scale. We manage billions total value locked across 15+ blockchain networks, powering yield strategies for partners including Kraken, Etherfi, and Plasma. Our protocol turns complex multi-chain DeFi positions into simple vault interfaces that institutional and retail users can actually trust.

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to be a key design partner in our next-generation platform infrastructure. You’ll own the systems architecture that sits behind billions in assets, event indexing, data pipelines, risk engines, multi-chain orchestration, the infrastructure that has to be right because real money depends on it.

You won’t be handed a spec. You’ll look at what we have, understand where we’re going, and figure out what needs to be built, rebuilt, or thrown away. Then you’ll build it.

THE ROLE

You’ll work with the team to evolve our production infrastructure from its current state into a platform that can scale with our growth. This means:

  • Designing and building the services that power our vault infrastructure, event indexing across 15+ chains, data platforms for risk calculation engines, real-time position tracking, and the orchestration layer that ties it all together.

  • Owning the cloud architecture end to end. We run on AWS. You’ll make decisions about how our services are deployed, how they scale, how they fail gracefully, and how we maintain them without hero culture.

  • Building data pipelines that are fast, correct, and auditable. Our vaults execute complex DeFi strategies across multiple protocols, Aave, Morpho, Uniswap, and more. The data infrastructure needs to keep pace with on-chain state across every network we operate on.

  • Making our systems observable and operable. Monitoring, alerting, runbooks, oncall-friendly architecture. You’ll help us move from “one person knows how this works” to “anyone on the team can diagnose this at 3am.”

  • Working across the boundary between on-chain and off-chain. Vault state lives on-chain. Risk calculations, indexing, caching, and API serving happen off-chain. You’ll design where that boundary sits and how data flows across it.

  • Communicating clearly about technical decisions. Writing design docs that the team can actually follow. Explaining tradeoffs to non-engineers. Turning ambiguity into shared understanding. This matters as much as the code.

YOU HAVE

  • Deep cloud architecture chops. Significant experience with AWS in production at scale.

  • You’ve designed and operated systems where uptime matters, not “we should have five nines” slide decks, but actual production systems handling real load with real consequences when they break.

  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals. You’ve built event-driven architectures, data pipelines, caching layers, and API services that handle high throughput. You know the difference between a system that works in a demo and one that works during a bull market.

  • IaC fluency. Terraform, CI/CD, containerization, Infrastructure as Code. You believe infrastructure should be reproducible, version-controlled, and reviewable.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can write clear design documents, explain architectural decisions to teammates with different backgrounds, and have productive disagreements about technical direction. You make the people around you better by making complex things understandable.

  • You’ve seen production at scale. You’ve lived through systems that scaled past their original design. You know what breaks first, what compromises are temporary, and what shortcuts become permanent regret.

  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You’ve formed strong views through experience and you’re willing to defend them, but you change your mind when presented with better information. You care about getting it right, not about being right.

EVEN BETTER IF

  • You have experience with blockchain data, indexing events, tracking on-chain state, dealing with reorgs, multi-chain consistency. Not required, but it’ll shorten your ramp significantly.

  • You’ve worked in DeFi or crypto infrastructure. You understand what a vault is, how yield strategies compose, and why TVL matters.

  • You have experience with Rust or Python in data-intensive contexts, we have systems in both.

  • You’ve built or operated multi-tenant platforms where different clients share infrastructure with isolation guarantees.

WHAT YOU’LL WALK INTO

We’re a 35-person team that’s raised $18M at Series A. The infrastructure works, it’s running in production handling billions in TVL, but it was built for the company we were, not the company we’re becoming. We’re transitioning from founder-dependent operations to scalable engineering practices. You’ll be a key part of making that real.

Current stack includes AWS, Python, Rust, microservices architecture, and smart contracts across 15+ EVM and non-EVM chains. We’re actively investing in Infrastructure as Code, containerization, CI/CD, and proper oncall rotations.

COMPENSATION

Competitive base salary plus equity. We’re a Series A company heading toward Series B — early enough that your equity is meaningful, late enough that the business is real.

We’re not building a prototype. We’re running production infrastructure that manages billions of dollars across dozens of blockchain networks for some of the biggest names in crypto. We need someone who knows how to make that kind of system reliable, scalable, and operable — and who can bring the rest of the team along while doing it.

OVERVIEW

Modern Treasury is hiring a Head of Risk to build our risk function from the ground up. Money moves through Modern Treasury for some of the largest and fastest-growing companies in the economy. How well we manage the risk in that movement directly shapes the product — who we can onboard, how fast they can transact, and how much friction they feel along the way.

This is a foundational, hands-on role. You will decide how customers are underwritten, how limits and reserves are set, how transactions are authorized, and how we detect fraud — and you will build those systems early, before scale forces the decisions for you.

This role reports to our General Counsel, who leads Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

ABOUT MODERN TREASURY

Modern Treasury provides trusted infrastructure for money movement. The company helps teams launch and scale payment experiences in days, not months. With best-in-class developer tools and a single API for fiat and stablecoins, plus built-in compliance, ledgering, and reporting, Modern Treasury enables businesses to move money instantly, reliably, and at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will start as an individual contributor with the mandate to build. You will own:

  • Onboarding & underwriting: How we evaluate customers before they move money with us — what we need to know to say yes, what conditions we attach, and how to reach that decision fast enough that it isn't the reason a customer picks someone else. You will partner with Compliance on KYB while owning the underwriting judgment beside it.

  • Transaction risk & limits: How we authorize money movement in real time, and how limits flex as we learn more about a business. This includes the hard cases — managing dynamic limits when a few customers drive most of the volume, and loosening constraints on good customers as fast as the data allows.

  • Reserves & exposure: Reserve policy and our view of loss exposure across ACH returns, unauthorized debits, and counterparty failure. You will quantify what we're exposed to, decide what's worth taking, and make that reasoning legible to the rest of the company.

  • Detection & the risk engine: The machinery. You will select and deploy the tooling — vendor, in-house, or both — that turns policy into automated decisions, and use modern AI tooling to automate case handling rather than staffing your way out of the problem.

  • New rails, stablecoins & wallet controls: The emerging surface area. You will help Modern Treasury expand into stablecoins, wallets, RfP, and local rails in other countries safely — understanding the risks unique to each rail, partnering with Product on controls that are both safe and usable, and designing for new money-movement patterns before they become edge cases at scale.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Compliance, Finance, and our customer-facing teams, and make sure risk and compliance run on one coherent set of systems rather than two stacks that disagree.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've built this before: You've stood up a risk function at an early-stage or high-growth company rather than inherited a mature one. You know what the first version looks like, what to defer, and what will hurt in eighteen months if you skip it now.

  • Payments risk, specifically: Not lending or credit. You understand ACH returns, settlement timing, unauthorized debit exposure, and counterparty risk. You know the difference between risk and compliance, and where they have to work as one.

  • Curiosity about new rails: Stablecoin, wallet, RfP, or international local-rail experience is a strong plus. More importantly, you are interested in learning unfamiliar rails quickly and translating their unique risks into practical product and operational controls.

  • A systems thinker, not a queue operator: You think about decisioning at scale and design for an order of magnitude more volume. You'll set thresholds and review edge cases by hand when needed, but you're building toward something that doesn't require it.

  • Technical and data fluency: You can go deep with engineers and hold your own. You're comfortable in the data yourself — SQL, ideally Python — and fluent in applying modern AI tools to operational problems.

  • Scar tissue, earned well: You've seen things go wrong — a fraud ring, a loss event, a control that failed in a way nobody anticipated — and carry the pattern recognition that comes with it. You were in the room, not the cause.

  • Judgment you can defend: You'll make consequential calls with incomplete information and get some wrong. You reason clearly about tradeoffs, write your thinking down, and can explain why a decision was right even when the outcome wasn't.

  • Influence across the company: You'll often be telling people something they don't want to hear. You can make the case for risk investment in terms the rest of the business cares about.

  • Management experience is a plus: You may hire onto this team within the first year. You don't need to have run a large org, but you should have managed before and want to build a team over time.

We're hiring a Product Manager to own a high-impact surface area across our risk and compliance infrastructure — and grow into a generalist across the broader product org.

This role sits at the center of:

  • Fraud and decisioning infrastructure — the systems that protect the platform and merchants at scale

  • Vendor and banking partner onboarding — owning the end-to-end process of procuring and implementing new payment providers, banks, and networks; coordinating requirements across engineering, legal, compliance, and operations to get partners live

We now need someone to own the growth layer on top of it: turning our brand and content momentum into repeatable, measurable pipeline.

This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's. You'll own outbound campaign activation, design and run growth experiments end-to-end, and tighten the loop between marketing spend and qualified pipeline. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Head of Marketing, Revenue, and Partnerships to find what works, kill what doesn't, and scale what does.

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

About The Role

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist to join our finance team. Our AP function is scaling quickly: processes are actively evolving and becoming more standardized as we grow, so we need someone who can execute reliably today while helping us build a better process for tomorrow.

The ideal candidate thinks on their feet, is not afraid to ask questions, operates on a “trust but verify” mindset, and leans on documentation and available resources rather than guessing. Just as importantly, they can see past our current processes and spot opportunities to improve them. This is a high-volume, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and wants ownership over how AP runs.

Key Responsibilities

  • High-volume AP processing. Process a high volume of invoices accurately and on time across inventory, capital expenditures, services, software, prepaids, and other categories, in a fast-paced environment.
  • PO and non-PO invoice handling. Perform two-way and three-way matching for PO-based invoices, and apply sound judgment to non-PO invoices to determine correct treatment (e.g., fixed assets such as office and lab equipment, prepaids such as leases and subscriptions, or operating expenses such as events, sponsorships, and services).
  • Vendor setup & onboarding. Set up and onboard new vendors, collect and verify required documentation, and maintain accurate, well-documented vendor records.
  • Cards & reimbursements. Process employee credit card transactions and expense reimbursements, ensuring proper coding, receipts, and policy compliance.
  • GL coding across entities. Code invoices to the correct GL and sub-accounts across multiple entities, cost centers, departments, and locations — using documentation as guidance while exercising critical thinking on exceptions.
  • Leverage automation. Use our OCR and AP automation tooling (Ramp) to review prepopulated fields, while ensuring manual accuracy and compliance before anything posts.
  • Resolve exceptions. Research, document, and resolve complex items such as intercompany chargebacks and transactions that don’t fit standard templates.
  • Document decisions. Take detailed notes on coding decisions and field definitions to support consistency, knowledge sharing, and repeatable processes as we standardize.
  • Improve the process. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows and proactively recommend improvements as the AP function matures and centralizes.
  • Collaborate efficiently. Collaborate with teammates to resolve open questions efficiently, batching items for supervisors rather than resolving everything ad hoc.
  • Month-end close. Support month-end close activities as needed, including reconciliations and reporting.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of accounts payable experience; experience in a high-volume or multi-entity environment strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with both two-way / three-way matching and non-PO invoice coding.
  • Experience setting up and onboarding vendors.
  • Strong understanding of expense coding, accruals, prepaids, and fixed assets.
  • Ability to navigate complex GL structures and apply critical thinking to new or unusual transactions while using internal documentation and policies as guidance.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with a habit of documenting processes and decisions clearly.
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP, PivotTables) required.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with evolving processes — and motivated to help improve them.

Preferred (Not Required)

  • Experience with NetSuite (our ERP) and Ramp (our OCR / spend platform).
  • Experience processing invoices for inventory and capital expenditures.
  • International AP exposure (VAT, FX).
  • Prior experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or another asset- and inventory-heavy industry.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
  • 401k
  • Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Equity

Learn more about the ITAR here.

This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

  • Ability to independently manage large bodies of work while surfacing blockers and driving cross-team resolution

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

As an integral member of Hadrian’s Special Projects division, you will work closely with the weld development team and engineering leadership on advanced R&D initiatives and customer-driven innovation. This division plays a dual role—leading moonshot engineering efforts and contributing expert guidance to new business opportunities.

We are seeking a skilled Welding Specialist to help establish and scale a high-performance fabrication and automation operation. This is a hands-on, technical role designed for a welding expert who excels in precision craftsmanship, process optimization, and collaborative problem-solving. You will support manual and robotic welding operations as part of a broader mission to develop manufacturing solutions for aerospace, automotive, maritime, and defense applications.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of advanced manufacturing in the U.S.—we’d be proud to have you build it with us.

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

  • Perform precision welding of aluminum and steel using GMAW and GTAW processes to meet industry and project-specific standards.
  • Interpret welding codes, blueprints, CAD models, and welding procedure specifications (WPS), including standards such as AWS D1.2.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot weld-related issues such as distortion, porosity, and fusion defects; develop and implement corrective actions.
  • Support welding inspections (visual, bend, NDT prep) and collaborate with engineers and quality assurance teams on process validation and qualification.
  • Maintain and calibrate welding equipment and support robotic, mechanized, and manual welding systems as required.

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; completion of trade school or technical certification preferred.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in welding, with demonstrated expertise in GMAW and GTAW processes.
  • Proven ability to weld aluminum and steel with a strong understanding of weld techniques, joint design, and distortion control.
  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings and working with part fixturing and lifting systems.
  • Familiarity with welding in varied environments, including confined spaces, elevated work areas, and hot work conditions.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience supporting or integrating robotic welding systems or automation in a production environment.
  • Ability to interpret nondestructive testing (NDT) results such as radiographic (x-ray) data for quality analysis.
  • Prior experience mentoring, training, or assessing the skill levels of team members in a fabrication setting.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Technical Data Intelligence has the mission of making the world’s engineering data legible to automation. Ingesting high variance engineering design data in the form of engineering drawings and CAD models is crucial to assess part and assembly manufacturability, plan build processes, plan factories, and drive manufacturing process automation. This team includes both machine learning engineers and fullstack software engineers.

You will build and manage a team of engineers focused on solving this problem. The solutions will be mix of agent development, classical ML development, and systems for tracking, editing, and mutating this data. This is a people-first management role: your focus is on hiring, growing, and supporting a world class team, while staying close to the technical work to help guide direction and staffing decisions, jumping in when necessary to unblock the critical path or understand the problems and technology on a deeper level.

What You'll Do

  • Own the people leadership of your engineers: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, career growth, and performance.
  • Stay technically hands-on as a player-coach: participate in design reviews and contribute directly to the work when it helps the team move faster or clears a critical path.
  • Set technical direction and where we invest headcount, in partnership with the engineers and technical leads who drive architecture and modeling decisions.
  • Build and maintain annotation tooling, implement active learning loops, and engineer synthetic data augmentation strategies.
  • Ensure engineers are engaged, growing, and set up to do their best work.

What We're Looking For

  • 2-5+ years of engineering management experience leading machine learning engineering teams in production, with strong technical depth and experience in machine learning, computer vision (detection/segmentation), multimodal image+text models, and/or data engineering before that.
  • Strong judgment on organizational design: how to structure a team, allocate headcount across projects, and balance depth vs. breadth as the stack grows.
  • Production deployment ownership: you've shipped models to production and been responsible for endpoint and model health.
  • A track record of running a healthy team: clear expectations, direct feedback, and a strong sense of ownership among your engineers.
  • Heavy interest in manufacturing: you either have past exposure to it or are excited to learn as much about it as possible from experts here and help others do the same. This is core to our culture.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills: you can align engineers, technical leads, and leadership.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Strong sense of connecting technical work and product development to business outcomes to understand what matters and what to say no to.
  • A track record of scaling a team through a period of fast headcount growth.
  • Experience mentoring engineers to grow into broader technical leadership roles.

About The Role

We are looking for an Accounts Payable Manager to lead and scale our AP function. This role will own the end-to-end AP process, manage and develop the AP team, and drive the standardization and controls we need as we grow across multiple entities.

Our processes are actively evolving. We need a leader who can bring order to a dynamic environment — building repeatable, well-documented workflows and stronger controls — while staying close enough to the details to jump in on complex invoices, coding decisions, and month-end close. The right person sets the standard for documentation and knowledge sharing, and continuously looks for ways to improve how AP runs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the AP team. Lead, mentor, and develop the AP team, including AP Specialists — setting priorities, reviewing work, managing workload across a high volume of invoices, and building bench strength as we scale.
  • Own the AP process. Own the full accounts payable process end to end — invoice intake and coding, PO and non-PO matching, approvals, payment runs, vendor onboarding, credit cards, and reimbursements — across multiple entities, cost centers, departments, and locations.
  • Standardize & document. Design, document, and standardize AP policies, workflows, and coding guidance; drive the ongoing centralization of AP as the company grows and adds entities.
  • Controls & compliance. Establish and enforce internal controls, approval thresholds, and segregation of duties; ensure compliance and audit readiness.
  • System ownership. Own and optimize our AP systems — NetSuite (ERP) and Ramp (OCR / spend) — including configuration, integrations, automation, and data integrity between platforms.
  • Vendor management. Manage the vendor program: vendor setup and onboarding standards, W-9 / documentation collection, master-data accuracy, and 1099 reporting.
  • Month-end close. Own AP month-end close: accruals, prepaids, fixed-asset coding, reconciliations, and reporting; ensure the sub-ledger ties to the GL and close deadlines are met.
  • Escalations & judgment. Resolve escalated and complex items — intercompany chargebacks, disputes, and transactions that don’t fit standard templates — and set the guidance so the team can handle them going forward.
  • Payments & cash flow. Manage cash-out timing and payment scheduling in partnership with Treasury / Finance; monitor aging, discounts, and vendor relationships.
  • Metrics & reporting. Define and track AP metrics (volume, cycle time, aging, exception rates) and report on performance and process-improvement initiatives to Finance leadership.
  • Cross-functional partner. Partner cross-functionally with Procurement, Operations, and department leaders to resolve issues, improve intake quality, and support company growth.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of accounts payable experience, including 2-3+ years managing or leading an AP team or function.
  • Proven experience owning full-cycle AP in a high-volume and/or multi-entity environment.
  • Strong command of both two-way / three-way matching and non-PO invoice coding, plus credit cards, reimbursements, and vendor onboarding.
  • Deep understanding of expense coding, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, and month-end close.
  • Experience building and documenting AP processes, policies, and internal controls in a scaling or changing environment.
  • Ability to navigate complex GL structures and apply sound judgment to new or unusual transactions.
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP, PivotTables) required; comfort analyzing and reconciling large data sets.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and people-leadership skills; a documentation-first, “trust but verify” mindset.

  • Hands-on NetSuite (ERP) and Ramp (OCR / spend) experience, including administration or optimization.

About Chainlink

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.
